title: Junior Associate - Operations
summary: You'll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.

This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.

You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. This support includes a partner from your local office or practice assigned to you to help guide your career as well as up to five weeks of formal training in your first two years as an associate. Additionally, you'll receive guidance and support from your local office or practice in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.

1+ years of professional experience
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

jd_text:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity.  We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

jd_text:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
Imagine a role that builds on your academic and personal capabilities, providing the most interesting business challenges and the opportunity to tackle them with the brightest and most supportive peer group. A role where you’ll make an impact from day one and be set on a global career path that will maximize your future career potential.
We have a long tradition of solving the most challenging problems with notable industry leaders and our junior consultants are the linchpins of this success. If you’re an ambitious individual who enjoys working with the brightest, most curious minds then we’d love you to join our team.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
As a junior consultant, your analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will be in thick of the action as you work side-by-side with some of the best in the business. And you will help create change.
Every day is different but a sample of the things you can expect to accomplish include:
Research the client organization and industry; interview, conduct focus groups and facilitate workshops with client employees, management teams and other stakeholders
Identify issues, create hypotheses and execute analysis; translate data into meaningful insights; present recommendations to key decision makers
Move the client to action; develop a plan to implement strategic recommendations; manage the execution.
Everything you do is geared toward achieving bottom-line results for our clients. Along the way, you will also learn to refine your interpersonal and people management skills. This helps you to properly identify client needs, build deeper client relationships and gain consensus—all of which make you a better leader.
Learning as a Bain JC takes many other forms, from formal global training programs to informal mentoring on a day-to-day basis. The overall experience is incredibly enriching from both a personal and a professional standpoint.
Successful Bain JCs are recognized not only for their excellent analytical skills but also for their interpersonal abilities and team skills.
Given the workload and performance expectations of this position, JCs are regularly required to work more than 60 hours/week to perform essential duties of the job.
ABOUT YOU:
MBA from a top business school; MDs, JDs, PhDs and experienced professionals are also encouraged to apply
Experience in consulting, a start-up or other business environment beneficial, but not required
A solid team player who’s also an independent thinker
A robust analytical skillset, endless curiosity and a penchant to think the impossible
Must be deadline driven, organized and able to multi-task
Strong verbal, written and presentation skills are important
Sharp problem-solving skills
A results-oriented track record
Solid leadership experience
A passion for consulting—and for life
Since Bain is a general management consulting firm, we are not looking for individuals with specific industry expertise. Our JCs do not enter an industry practice area and do not specialize until later in their careers. We look for people who possess a high level of energy and a sincere desire to affect change in diverse industries on diverse client challenges.
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external institutions such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
summary: We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Product Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Product Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

jd_text:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Product Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
A BCG Product Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
YOU'RE GOOD AT
Product Management
· Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
· Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
· Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
· Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
· Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
· Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
· Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones
Product Delivery
· As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
· Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
· Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
· Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
· Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
· Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap
AI-Native ways of working
· Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
· Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
· Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
· Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
· Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
· Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
· Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines
What You'll Bring
Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration
· 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
· Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
· Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
· A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
· Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
· Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
· Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
· Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
· Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1
Who You'll Work With
• Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
• Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
• Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
• Topic/Product/Case Leadership

summary: Du arbeitest in Teams aus üblicherweise 3 bis 5 Berater:innen mit ganz unterschiedlichem Background (Finanzen, Medizin oder Naturwissenschaften) und unterstützt Investoren und ihre Portfoliounternehmen über den gesamten Transaktionszyklus hinweg, u.a. bei Due Diligences, zu Wertschöpfungsthemen und bei der Entwicklung von Exit-Strategien. Der Healthcare-Investor-Sektor wächst stetig und ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, dieses wachstumsstarke Geschäftsfeld weiterzuentwickeln und voranzutreiben.

Neben der transaktionsbezogenen Arbeit hast du die Gelegenheit, direkt mit Portfoliounternehmen an der Ausgestaltung ihrer Wertschöpfungsagenda zusammenzuarbeiten, und bringst Unternehmen, die den Gesundheitssektor künftig prägen und gestalten werden, auf den Weg. Dabei arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unseren Spezialist:innen, u.a. Geschäftsgründer:innen, Designer und Advanced-Analytics-Expert:innen. Strukturierung unklarer Probleme und Ableitung von Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen aus komplexen Informationen anhand qualitativer und quantitativer Methoden. Wenn du dich für eine Karriere bei McKinsey entscheidest, wirst du Mitglied eines Unternehmens, das gezielt in deine berufliche Weiterentwicklung investiert.

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. WHY BAIN
Bain is a launchpad for your career, where you’ll work on the most interesting challenges alongside a bright and supportive peer group who will push your thinking, celebrate your progress, and grow with you.
From day one, you’ll build a strong foundation and business toolkit, working across a wide range of industries and contributing to work that helps global clients, including senior executives and C-level leaders, address complex strategic issues and translate them into actionable plans.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Associate Consultants are integral members of our consulting teams, working alongside teammates across levels on case teams embedded within client organizations, including many of the world’s leading companies. You’ll bring fresh thinking, structured problem solving, and a collaborative spirit to help solve high-impact business challenges.
Here’s a snapshot of what you’ll do:
Break down complex problems using hypothesis-led thinking and rigorous analysis to generate insights that shape strategic decisions
Own discrete workstreams such as market sizing, financial modeling, scenario planning, or benchmarking to deliver clear, actionable recommendations
Use data, tools, and digital platforms, which may include Bain’s proprietary platforms and emerging capabilities such as generative AI to support analysis and decision making
Adapt and deliver by taking on varied responsibilities depending on the needs of each case, from research and analysis to implementation support
HOW BAIN WILL SUPPORT YOU
While the learning curve is steep and the work is challenging, you’ll be supported every step of the way through training, mentorship, and a culture that helps you thrive. You’ll learn from colleagues across regions, tapping into Bain’s global network of expertise, resources, and shared communities. Whether on a case, in training, or through firmwide initiatives, you’ll build meaningful relationships and expand your perspective.

This role is ideal for final-year undergraduates, non-MBA master’s students, or early career professionals. Eligibility and application deadlines vary by office. Please refer to our office information for additional details.

We seek highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills, adept at prioritizing shifting workloads in dynamic industries. V EY smo predani oblikovanju vaše prihodnosti s samozavestjo.
Pomagali vam bomo uspeti v globalno povezanem središču raznolikih ekip in vas popeljati na vašo karierno pot, kamor želite.

Razvijamo strategije, ki premikajo poslovanje naših naročnikov naprej. Povezujemo poglobljene analize z idejami, ki imajo resničen vpliv na to, kako delujejo podjetja okoli nas. Dali vam bomo priložnost, da spoznate širok nabor industrij in sodelujete pri projektih, ki podjetjem prinašajo pozitivne spremembe.
Vaša vloga v ekipi
Predstavljajte si podjetje, ki želi vstopiti na nov mednarodni trg. Za to je treba zbrati ključne informacije – analizirati trende rasti, prepoznati glavne dejavnike in oceniti konkurenčno okolje. Naša ekipa oceni izvedljivost vstopa na trg in pripravi strategije za uspeh. To pomeni reševanje kompleksnih izzivov v tesnem timskem sodelovanju. Sodelovali boste tudi pri projektih rasti, pripravi strategij prevzemov ter podpori pri integracijah podjetij. Ob tem boste pridobivali vpoglede v različne industrije, podprti z znanjem izkušenih sodelavcev in poglobljenim analitičnim delom.
Kaj je za nas pomembno
Zavedamo se, da ste na začetku kariere, vendar nekaj stvari je pri tej vlogi ključnih.

Izvajanje poglobljenih tržnih analiz
: samostojno boste izvajali obsežne raziskave trgov ter uporabljali različna analitična orodja in metode za oblikovanje vpogledov.

: aktivno boste vključeni v iniciative, povezane z vstopom na trg, načrti rasti in širitvami.
Priprava analitičnih poročil
: pripravljali boste poglobljena poročila in predstavitve, ki vključujejo ugotovitve analiz, študije izvedljivosti in strateška priporočila.

strategije; predhodne izkušnje

ujemati se moramo kot ekipa

Senior Consultant - EY Parthenon

The most important things in a few sentences
We develop strategies that move our clients' businesses forward. In our work, we combine rigorous analysis with ideas that have a real impact on how the companies you see around you operate. We will give you the chance to get to know a diverse range of industries and be a part of projects that change companies for the better.
Your role in the team
Imagine a situation where a company targets a new international market. This initiative requires gathering critical information - analyzing the market's growth trends, identifying key drivers, and evaluating the competitive environment. Our team's role is to assess the feasibility of entering the market and to develop successful strategies. This involves tackling complex challenges collaboratively as a team. Additionally, you'll participate in projects aimed at driving growth, crafting acquisition strategies, and facilitating smooth company integrations. Along the way, you'll gain valuable insights across multiple industries through in-depth analysis, supported by the expertise of experienced colleagues.

We know you're just starting your career. But here are a few things that are important for this job:

Contributing to Strategic Projects:

Plan and execute qualitative and quantitative analyses, feasibility studies, and strategic recommendations.

Apply a problem-solving mindset to dissect complex challenges encountered during market entry evaluations or strategic projects.

based on individual performance and all company EY Slovenia.

online meeting with one of our recruiters

V EY smo predani oblikovanju vaše prihodnosti s samozavestjo.
Pomagali vam bomo uspeti v globalno povezanem središču raznolikih ekip in vas popeljati na vašo karierno pot, kamor želite.

Razvijamo strategije, ki premikajo poslovanje naših naročnikov naprej. Povezujemo poglobljene analize z idejami, ki imajo resničen vpliv na to, kako delujejo podjetja okoli nas. Vaša vloga v ekipi
Predstavljajte si podjetje, ki želi vstopiti na nov mednarodni trg. Za to je treba zbrati ključne informacije – analizirati trende rasti, prepoznati glavne dejavnike in oceniti konkurenčno okolje. Naša ekipa oceni izvedljivost vstopa na trg in pripravi strategije za uspeh. To pomeni reševanje kompleksnih izzivov v tesnem timskem sodelovanju. Sodelovali boste tudi pri projektih rasti, pripravi strategij prevzemov ter podpori pri integracijah podjetij. Ob tem boste pridobivali vpoglede v različne industrije, podprti z znanjem izkušenih sodelavcev in poglobljenim analitičnim delom.
Kaj je za nas pomembno
Zavedamo se, da ste na začetku kariere, vendar nekaj stvari je pri tej vlogi ključnih.

Izvajanje poglobljenih tržnih analiz

Strateški prispevek in izvedba

Učenje in timsko delo

Vodenje projektov:
vodili boste manjše projektne time ter skrbeli za doseganje projektnih mejnikov.

sposobnost vzpostavljanja močnih odnosov z naročniki, razumevanja njihovih potreb ter zagotavljanja visokokakovostne storitve.

jd_text:
FS Consulting, Product, Sales & Distribution Transformation Consultant (Senior Associate - Manager)
Singapore
Job Description
Role Overview:
We are looking for a Transformation Consultant to join our Financial Services Consulting practice in Singapore. The role focuses on transforming banks’ front to middle office operations – from customer strategy and sales/service processes to target operating model (TOM) design – to drive efficiency, innovation, and improved client outcomes. You will work with leading banks (across retail, commercial, private banking, etc.) to analyze their current organization and processes, then design future-state solutions encompassing operating model changes, process re-engineering, and digital enablement. As a Senior Associate, you will deliver core analyses and support project delivery; as a Manager, you will lead engagements, manage stakeholders, and ensure projects meet their strategic objectives.
Key Responsibilities:
Front-Office Consulting Projects: Collaborate with client teams to identify pain points and improvement opportunities in front-office functions (e.g. customer lifecycle management, sales processes, product management, relationship management, digital channels). Develop recommendations to bridge gaps between the current state and desired future state – whether by redesigning business processes, implementing new digital tools, or developing new operating models for front-line teams
Target Operating Model Design: Lead efforts to design and implement target operating models (TOM) for front-office transformation. Define clear roles, processes, governance, and technology requirements to support new front-office strategies at scale (e.g. redesign of sales and service structures, integration of digital channels, product lifecycle management). Ensure that the new TOM aligns with clients’ strategic objectives and incorporates best practices in customer experience and operational efficiency
Project Leadership & Delivery: For Manager-level hires, oversee end-to-end project management – including planning engagement scope, managing project teams (often multi-disciplinary), tracking project milestones, and ensuring quality delivery of outcomes
Change Management & Implementation: Support clients in executing transformation initiatives, including change management, stakeholder alignment, and implementation planning. Develop actionable roadmaps and implementation plans (e.g. phased roll-out of new processes, staff training plans, customer communication strategies) to ensure sustainable adoption of new front-office models
Client Engagement & Thought Leadership: Work closely with KPMG partners and directors on client management and business development activities. Build credible relationships with client stakeholders (from front-line managers to C-suite) by demonstrating understanding of their business, and by delivering tangible value. Contribute to internal knowledge development – for example, by creating thought leadership on trends (agentic sales transformation, service evolution, lending transformation etc.) and helping to refine KPMG’s front line sales, service and product transformation offerings
⠀
Required Experience & Skills:
Relevant Experience: 5 - 8+ years of professional experience in banking or consulting, with a focus on operations, business transformation, or process improvement. Experience with target operating model projects, sales & service effectiveness, or front-line technology implementation (e.g. CRM systems, digital banking platforms) is highly valued
Consulting & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities – able to assess complex operational issues, carry out data-driven analysis (process mapping, efficiency analysis, etc.), and derive actionable solutions. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills are essential, as is the ability to craft clear recommendations and business cases for change. Prior consulting experience or project management exposure is a plus
Industry & Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of banking functions and trends – such as sales and relationship management, customer service processes, digital channels and customer experience innovations, and operational best practices in wholesale, commercial or private banking. Familiarity with methodologies like Lean Six Sigma or process re-engineering is advantageous for addressing efficiency improvements and process redesign
Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills both written and verbal, to effectively engage with client stakeholders and produce high-quality reports and presentations. Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work seamlessly in a team environment and manage stakeholders at multiple levels. For Manager roles, robust stakeholder and change management skills are required to facilitate buy-in and navigate organizational complexities during transformation
Preferred Qualifications:
Education: A minimum of a bachelor’s degree. An MBA or other advanced degree is considered a strong asset, especially with specialization in operations management, strategy, or financial services
Certifications: Credentials in Project Management (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) or Process Improvement (e.g. Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt) are beneficial
Leadership & Management: For Manager-level candidates, demonstrated experience in leading project teams or significant workstreams in a consulting or corporate environment

Senior Consultant in the Delivering Deal Value Team
Sofia
Job Description & Summary
Delivering Deal Value (DDV) is a Sofia-based team that operates as part of the wider Deals practise within PwC Bulgaria and is planned to triple over the next few years. While based in Sofia, the team effectively functions as an extension of the DDV UK team in London. This means that all the DDV work is on UK and global deals predominantly with mid- and large-cap international companies.
DDV UK is a market leader in assisting both Corporate and Private Equity clients in a wide range of high impact business situations. Most of its work is in the Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) space, both pre and post deal. The M&A deals DDV UK works on range in size from £50m to over £10bn and the clients include some of the most well-known brands and businesses in the world
As part of the DDV team in Sofia, you will not be aligned to a sector or specialist team. The type of client projects you work on will vary based on the demand and the current deal market, therefore a high degree of flexibility is expected.
About the role:
We help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and operational challenges. Our work is often complex and fast paced; at the same time, the opportunities for personal and career development are vast. You will be working alongside your UK colleagues on a range of projects across the different products we offer as a team, including:
Carve out and divestment support
– i.e. What does the business look like in a standalone state? What support and transition services will it need to function? How can we help our clients execute the separation and ensure a smooth Day 1?
M&A Integration
– i.e. How can our clients protect and grow value in an acquisition, what is the right level of integration to achieve this and what does an effectively-run integration programme look like? Where are the synergies between two businesses and how well has the plan for capturing these synergies been compiled?
Operational due diligence
– i.e. Has the business been performing well? What does its operating model look like, is it sustainable and fit for purpose, are there any associated operational risks? What could be improved to reduce costs and unlock further value for our client?
Post-acquisition performance improvement using our Rapid Value Creation methodology
– i.e. Where might value lie in the business and how can we generate sustainable cost savings?
As a Senior Associate in the DDV team, your typical responsibilities will include:
Leading small workstreams in large projects, or supporting big workstreams. As part of this, owning key pieces of operational analysis and deliverables
Leading analysis and developing hypotheses in conjunction with more senior team members, as well as working on hypotheses and analysis requested by more senior team members
Owning relationships with individual members of a client team
Contributing to business development activities, such as the creation of proposals, discussion documents and other
Developing internal relationships with DDV UK and within PwC Bulgaria
Supporting the onboarding and coaching of new members of the team

Background in: a) M&A / Deals; b) direct operational or process improvement experience; c) change projects / Consulting; or d) audit

Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills - including attention to detail, ability to present complex information in simple ways, and an eye for slide / table aesthetics
Excellent verbal and written communication - all work will be in English, often with native speakers (from DDV UK and end clients)

Stakeholder management - ability to quickly develop rapport and build strong relationships (within DDV UK and with end clients)
Resilience - self-starter, comfortable with uncertainty, thrives under pressure and able to flex working hours to meet deadlines
Natural curiosity - ability to apply logic and problem solving to difficult business problems
Financial acumen - comfort around financial analysis and in understanding the drivers of financial information related to technology components
Analytics - ability to quickly process large amounts of information and draw out hypotheses and key messages
Experience around operational analysis to understand business processes, their associated costs and potential issues as well as opportunities for improvement (desirable but not essential)
Comfort in understanding the impact of different operating models on commercial, financial and operational aspects of a business, ideally in the context of a transaction (desirable but not essential)

jd_text:
FS Consulting, Fintech & Innovation Consultant (Senior Associate - Manager)
Singapore
Job Description
Role Overview:
We are seeking a Fintech & Innovation Consultant to join our Financial Services Consulting – Fintech & Ventures team in Singapore. In this role, you will work with banks, regulators, and fintech companies to drive strategic transformation and innovation. You’ll help clients navigate the convergence of finance and technology by developing growth strategies, market entry plans, partnerships, and digital business models that leverage fintech solutions for competitive advantage. This position requires a blend of strategic thinking and practical execution: as a consultant, you will conduct analyses and support project delivery, while as a Manager you will lead projects and guide teams to deliver results and manage client relationships.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Advisory for Fintech Initiatives: Lead and support consulting engagements focused on fintech strategy, digital transformation, and innovation in financial services. Advise clients on developing and executing strategies for fintech-driven growth, new digital product launches, and market entry or expansion, including assessing market opportunities, competitive positioning, and regulatory implications
Business Model & Partnership Development: Work closely with client executives to design and refine business models and value propositions for financial products and services. This may involve evaluating partnership strategies between banks and fintechs, digital platform strategies, or ecosystem development (e.g. API/open banking partnerships, corporate venture investments in fintech, creating multi-sided platforms). Help clients identify opportunities for revenue growth, improved customer engagement and operational efficiency through fintech solutions
Market and Trend Analysis: Keep up to date with fintech and broader financial services innovation industry trends (such as digital banking, payments innovation, AI, digital assets, e-commerce, Insurtech, RegTech etc.) and provide thought leadership on how these trends impact clients’ businesses and strategy. Conduct market research and fintech landscape analysis to inform client strategy engagements, including competitor benchmarking and regulatory trend analysis
Solution Design & Implementation: Translate strategic recommendations into actionable plans. For example, develop roadmaps for fintech implementation (covering operating model changes, technology enablement, and organizational implications). For Manager-level hires, responsibilities include project managing large-scale strategy engagements – structuring work plans, facilitating client workshops, coordinating cross-functional KPMG and client teams, and ensuring timely, high-quality deliverables. Consultants will contribute by performing critical analysis (financial model, process mapping, etc.), drafting client reports, and working closely with managers to execute project tasks
Client & Team Engagement: Collaborate with KPMG partners and senior leaders in proposals and business development for fintech or innovation related opportunities. Build strong client relationships by understanding client needs in the fintech/innovation domain and delivering insightful, value-added solutions. Support internal practice development by developing points-of-view and thought leadership on fintech and digital strategy topics to share with clients and the broader market
⠀
Required Experience & Skills:
Financial Services & Technology Background: 5 - 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services or consulting environments, preferably with significant exposure to fintech, digital banking, e-commerce or innovation strategy roles. A track record of delivering strategic projects in areas like digital banking, fintech startups, platforms, payment innovations, or tech-driven business transformation is essential
Consulting & Analytical Skills: Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities – able to break down complex business issues, perform structured analysis, and synthesize insights into clear recommendations. Prior consulting experience (e.g. in a strategy or management consulting role) or internal corporate strategy experience in FS/fintech is an asset, demonstrating capability in managing projects and delivering client value
Fintech Domain Knowledge: Good understanding of fintech business models and emerging financial technologies. Familiarity with how fintech innovations (digital payments, blockchain, AI in finance, digital lending, etc.) are reshaping banking and financial services. Knowledge of key success factors for fintech adoption (e.g. user experience, agility, platform models) and challenges (e.g. regulatory compliance, scaling) will be valuable
Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) to articulate strategies and technical concepts effectively to both clients and technical teams. Strong stakeholder management capabilities – able to work collaboratively with diverse client and internal teams and build trust-based relationships. Skilled in creating polished presentations and reports for senior audiences
Adaptability & Drive: Demonstrated adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast-evolving environment. Passion for fintech and innovation, with a self-motivated attitude to stay on top of industry developments and continuously develop expertise
Preferred Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (required). MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is highly desirable – especially with specialization in strategy, finance, or innovation
Professional Certifications: Additional credentials such as Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Project Management Professional (PMP), or certifications in digital transformation/innovation are a plus
Leadership Experience: For Manager-level candidates, prior experience in leading project teams or managing consulting engagements is advantageous, demonstrating effective project leadership and team management

At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Climate change is driving an unprecedented transformation in the global energy sector. The energy industry is transitioning to a low carbon, decentralised future, facing a wide range of engineering and economic challenges along the way. The scale of infrastructure development needed to transform our energy sector is immense with investments and transactions in the energy sector expected to continue to grow over the next decade. Do you want to be part of this journey in our growing team?
EY-ROAM is a leading provider of electricity market modelling services in Australia and New Zealand. Our role in the energy industry is to provide evidence-based insights, enabling our clients to make informed decisions amidst uncertainty and change, cutting through the complexity to provide actionable insights.
We simulate electricity markets and power systems to forecast how they change in different future scenarios. Our market models use a physics first approach where representation of the transmission network is key. Our clients span the energy value chain including renewable energy and storage developers, energy sector investors, transmission and distribution network service providers, retailers, regulators and governments.
This is a hybrid position based in Meanjin – Brisbane or Warrang – Sydney.

Technologie is tegenwoordig een belangrijk onderdeel bij transformaties binnen organisaties en heeft daarbij impact op de structuur van organisaties en de manier van werken. Als Senior Consultant Technology Strategy & Transformation begeleid je organisaties bij veranderingen, variërend van kortlopende strategische trajecten (zoals het ontwerpen van de IT-visie, strategie en operating model) tot langdurige transformatieprogramma’s en (technologie) implementaties die de organisatie en werkwijze fundamenteel veranderen. Je vervult een leidende rol, waarin je onder meer verantwoordelijk bent voor de volgende werkzaamheden:
Ondersteuning van klanten bij de ontwikkeling van technologie, IT-visie, strategie, operating model, organisatie-inrichting, governance en kostenoptimalisatie.
Advisering aan klanten bij het (strategisch) ontwerp en implementatie van de nieuwste technologische innovaties, zoals Gen AI of grote platformen zoals SAP en Microsoft.

Voorbereiden van C-level besluitvormingsmaterialen, ondersteund door gedegen analyses en heldere storytelling.

jd_text:
Senior Consultant - Manufacturing - Supply Chain and Operations - Industries
Diegem, BE, 1831
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area within EY, and this with a huge potential for you. It offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Our competency teams are focused on helping our clients to improve their business performance and operational efficiency, whilst managing risk. We help clients by delivering assessment, transformation and assurance solutions in specialty areas, like finance, supply chain, strategic choices, risk management, cyber security and technology.
Shape the future with confidence.
The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits?
Manufacturers have long pursued manufacturing excellence programs to continually improve the performance of their facilities and equipment. Many of those initiatives were successful for a time, but they’ve lacked staying power. Today, most manufacturers still struggle to achieve — and sustain — higher levels of performance. And now they also have to deal with escalating digital disruption that increasingly challenges their competitiveness and ability to grow.
Our EY teams understand how to improve productivity for smarter, faster and more advanced manufacturing. With our EY Smart Factory methodology and our unique partnership with P&G at the foundation, we help our clients achieve operational efficiency across the organization to build a better tomorrow!
EY has been rated one of the leading manufacturing consulting firms in the world, and very few organizations match the scope, scale, and ability to lead companies through a sustainable manufacturing transformation. For our growing Supply Chain and Operations practice in Belgium we are looking for a Senior Consultant – Manufacturing to strengthen our manufacturing team.
Your Key Responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant you support and (co-)lead project delivery teams improving our client’s business performance, in line with our Exceptional Client Service approach, while helping grow our practice outside of your client work. Drawing on your knowledge, skills and experience, you will start to build valued relationships with external clients and internal peers, support bids, proposals and thought leadership.
You will work independently as well as in teams. You will coach and support consultants and client team members, perform analyses and report finding and results. You will share your expertise with other colleagues in the manufacturing excellence team of EY Belgium, residing in the broader Supply Chain & Operations team.
In addition, you’ll actively establish and strengthen the relationships with our regional and global Manufacturing leadership teams and take part in our international communities.
Your knowledge and experience, combined with EY’s thought leadership on the future of Manufacturing and Maintenance, will allow you to provide innovative insights for clients, adapting our service offerings, solutions, and methods to fit the operational teams and cultural needs.
You are thorough and result-oriented and work together with the client on implementing solutions. You often work in an international environment on projects with a significant impact on company results.
Your Profile
You have:
A master’s degree in Business, Industrial or Civil Engineering, or related field with strong academic records;
A minimum of 3 years professional experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering sustained improvements in business performance through operational excellence programs, gained in industry and/or consulting;
Passion for the manufacturing/production/maintenance environment and you can rely on a first experience in this field; preferably combined with sector knowledge in FMCG and/or Life Sciences.
Proven experience in managing and improving production lines
Proven experience in running improvement projects aiming to eliminate line losses (breakdown, maintenance, …)
Proven experience in managing and coaching shopfloor teams
Experience with delivering trainings on operational excellence to large groups (root cause analysis, data analysis, …)
Fluent language skills - written and spoken English, French and/or Dutch;
Knowledge and deep interest in manufacturing trends like Industry 4.0, (I)IoT, AI, Smart Manufacturing, Sustainability, Cyber Security
Strong affinity with AI and genuine interest in applying new AI trends in a professional context;
Ideally, you’ll also have
A lean six sigma green or black belt and/or demonstrated experience with P&G’s IWS
Consulting experience or acted as internal consultant in the industry
A preference for sustainable solution development instead of a ‘fix it when it breaks’ mentality.
Great coaching and leadership approach.
Entrepreneurial spirit, excellent communication skills & passion for winning;
Intrinsic motivation to help establish and strengthen relationships with our clients;
Commitment to support the development of others through coaching and counselling team members.
Willingness to execute projects abroad with frequent on site presence.
The capability to spot where to find new value in supply chain and manufacturing and explain it simple.
What’s In It For You
EY Family
– you become part of the EY Family providing you with all the necessary skills, training and opportunities; enabling you to grow to your fullest potential.
Attractive remuneration package
- We offer an attractive remuneration package; including a company car and charging card, iPhone plus subscription, health insurance, pension plan, meal vouchers, and eco vouchers. Thanks to our flex plan it is possible to choose what you value most.
Mobility package
- You’ll be able to opt-in for the mobility budget. In return for giving up your (right to a) company car, you’ll receive a monthly budget from EY as compensation. This budget will allow you to use your employer-provided compensation for alternative transportation means or similar benefits, incl. reimbursement of housing costs (on condition you live within 10km of your main place of employment).
Flexible working arrangements
- We are proud of our flexible working arrangements. We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities. We offer flexible working hours and working from home multiple days per week is possible.
Inspiring work environment
- At EY we are dedicated to providing you with an inspiring work environment. A work environment that allows you to further develop your skills and enables you to fulfill your true potential.
Learning & personal growth
- You will benefit from an onboarding program, receive extensive training and will be coached by a counselor. We offer a clear career path tailored to your unique skills with necessary guidance.
Artificial Intelligence
– stay up to date with the latest AI trends through our extensive training opportunities and integrated AI systems. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in a smart and efficient way in your day-to-day work, while developing skills to identify, quantify and track value creation when integrating AI into client environments.
Fun
- By joining our EY- teams, you can participate in team activities, and companywide events and enjoy a drink during our monthly after-work drink.
Sustainability
- We have a fleet of hybrid and electric cars. Our flex plan makes it possible for you to choose the most sustainable option for you. You can also opt for a train subscription or lease a bike.
Diversity & Inclusion
- At EY we are passionate about the inclusion and support of individuals of all groups; we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.
Location
- All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and
have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided.
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

Kraków
Job Description & Summary
We are a multilingual and multidisciplinary team, bringing together people with backgrounds ranging from humanities to finance, operations, technology and data. We have gained experience across different industries, but we share one goal:
helping clients around the world design practical business solutions and build more effective Global Business Services organizations.
Our projects cover the full Global Business Services journey, including operating model design, location analysis, organizational transformation, process optimization, center setup and the improvement of existing operations.
How we work:
We thrive in dynamic environments. Our projects often evolve quickly, requiring frequent adjustments and short decision cycles. You’ll be comfortable working with incomplete information and turning ambiguity into action.
We are agile and iterative. We experiment, pilot, and iterate solutions with our clients, focusing on quick wins that pave the way for sustainable change.
We are cross-functional by design. If your background is in HR, you might lead a Finance or Procurement workstream next. We match people to problems, not to silos - there are no fixed rules.
We are solution-focused and optimistic. We bring energy, creativity and a can-do attitude to every challenge. When the path isn’t obvious, we figure out the next best step and move forward.
We co-create with our clients. We facilitate workshops, rapidly synthesize insights, and turn them into Target Operating Models, process designs and transformation roadmaps.
We learn continuously across functions and technologies. Whether in Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain or Technology, we stay current on domain best practices, regulations and enabling platforms.

Consultant in Global Business Services Team (GBS
)

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow by using the practice’s sophisticated tools and methodologies, whilst having the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships. You will also have the chance to work with and learn from some of the top practitioners in our firm.

Cost reduction / simplification
Business architecture
Digital and process transformation
Technology delivery
Risk transformation
Controls efficiency and automation
Regulatory impact assessment, gap analysis, design and implementation

Designing and implementing operating models;
Analysing the cost base of banks / functions to identify cost reduction opportunities;
Performing process modelling and target state process design;
Supporting work streams on large scale technology programmes
Performing regulatory impact assessments, gap analysis, design and implementations;
Translating regulatory requirements into tangible business transformation and improvements to ensure robust controls
You will also be expected to support internal projects and business development work.

Knowledge and experience in contributing to the implementation of emerging technologies and their impact on Capital Markets (e.g., GenAI, analytics, process automation).
Risk and Regulatory Change:
Knowledge of the UK and European financial regulatory environment.
Practical understanding of first and second line of defence functions and their roles within the front-to-back risk management framework. This includes an understanding of non-financial risks (e.g., operational risk, conduct risk).

The Economic Advisory team is looking for candidates with (or currently studying for) a Master’s Degree (or higher) to join our team of economists, based in London, Cambridge, and Manchester in September 2027.

Working across issues in policy, regulation, and subsidy control; business cases; economic appraisal and evaluation; energy market assessment and modelling; macroeconomics and supply chain, and
Working in a variety of sectors including Energy & Utilities; Defence, Security & Justice; Transport; Real Estate & Regeneration; Central Government; Healthcare & Life Sciences.

At Deloitte, you will apply microeconomic and macroeconomic theory alongside economic and econometric modelling to address business, consumer and regulatory issues facing our clients. This could involve shaping policy and regulatory frameworks in the energy and transport sectors, developing and appraising investment strategies, building macroeconomic models and forecasts for governments,
assessing the economic and social impacts of major infrastructure projects or considering value-for-money from public sector investments.

Build long-lasting relationships with colleagues based on mutual respect and trust.

Develop report writing, team working, project management skills and the commercial application of economic theory.
Continue with your professional development throughout your career through training opportunities across both soft and technical skills.
Work in multi-disciplinary teams across Deloitte on major projects for both public and private sector clients.
Experience different cultures and local business practices, whilst working with colleagues and clients around the world, as well as enjoying opportunities for national and international travel and secondments as part of a diverse team with an inclusive culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. The role emphasizes strong analytical execution, clear communication of results, and an interest in how analytics is used in real operational decisions. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:
Analytical Problem Solving
Support structuring of operational, logistics, and planning challenges as analytical problems under uncertainty.
Contribute to analysis of trade‑offs involving capacity, inventory, risk, service levels, and timing.
Apply quantitative techniques with appropriate rigor based on guidance from senior team members.
Applied Modelling & Analysis

Support model testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to ensure outputs are reliable and decision‑relevant.
Technology & Tools
Develop and maintain analytics code, models, and supporting documentation.
Work with data from multiple systems and sources.
Support documentation of business rules, data requirements, process flows, and reporting logic.
Tools may include Python, R, and SQL; optimization solvers; simulation libraries; and enterprise or cloud data platforms.
Follow governed, auditable analytics and documentation practices.
Team & Stakeholder Support
Work collaboratively within project teams to deliver high‑quality analytical outputs.
Support preparation of materials and insights for client discussions.
Proactively flag data, modelling, or assumption risks to senior team members.
Work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

Degree in operations, industrial/systems engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field.

Vienna, AT, 1220

Dein Team & Umfeld
Unser rund 90-köpfiges Business Consulting Team unterstützt Unternehmen bei Transformationsvorhaben und Prozessoptimierungen. Das Banking & Capital Markets-Team rund um Philipp Schöckler berät Banken, Asset Manager und FinTechs zu Themen wie Digitalisierung, Prozessoptimierung, Finance- und Risikothemen, regulatorischen Anforderungen sowie Zukunftsthemen wie Künstlicher Intelligenz und Digital Assets.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten
Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen und Übersetzung in technische Lösungen
Strukturierung und Priorisierung von Requirements (z. B. User Stories, Use Cases, BPMN)
Mitgestalten an Transformationsprojekten im Banking & Capital Markets Umfeld
Unterstützung bei Projektplanung, Umsetzung und Stakeholder-Management
Erstellung von Präsentationen und Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen
Beobachtung von Trends (z. B. ESG, Digitalisierung) und Unterstützung bei Studien und Vertriebsaktivitäten

Abgeschlossenes Studium mit wirtschaftlichem oder finanziellem Schwerpunkt (z. B. Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik o. Ä.)
Erste Berufserfahrung bis hin zu mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Banking- , Finance- oder Beratungsumfeld
Erfahrung in der Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen und der Übersetzung in technische Lösungen
Verständnis von geschäftskritischen Backend-Systemen, modernen IT-Architekturen oder CRM-Plattformen
Sicherer Umgang mit KI-gestützten Tools beziehungsweise Interesse daran, neue Technologien im Arbeitsalltag aktiv einzusetzen
Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen und relevanten Stakeholder:innen
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau)
Nice-to-haves:
Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering (z. B. User Stories, BPMN)
Erfahrung in Modernisierungs- oder Transformationsprojekten im Banking-, Financial-Services- oder FinTech-Umfeld
Verständnis von Softwarearchitekturen sowie Berührungspunkte mit agiler Entwicklung, Testing, Low-Code-Plattformen oder BSI

Flexibilität im Alltag:
Homeoffice, Workation, Sabbatical sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle ermöglichen eine individuelle Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags.
Mobilität:
Übernahme der Kosten für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie zusätzliche Angebote wie Bike-Leasing erleichtern deinen Weg ins Office.

Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, klare Entwicklungsziele und transparente Leistungsbeurteilung begleiten deinen Karriereweg bei EY.
Weiterentwicklung
: Vielfältige Trainings, Coachings und Lernangebote unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
Wellbeing:
Angebote wie kostenfreie psychologische Beratung, Coaching-Möglichkeiten sowie Initiativen zur mentalen Unterstützung stärken dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.
Sport & Ausgleich:
Vergünstigtes myClubs Abo mit Zugang zu vielfältigen Sport- und Freizeitangeboten fördern den Ausgleich im Alltag.
„Bring a Friend“:
Das eigene Netzwerk lohnt sich – Empfehlungen werden mit einer Prämie honoriert.
Das jährliche Bruttogehalt für diese Position beträgt bei Einstieg auf Rank Consultant € 49.000 (exklusive Bonus, All-in-Vertrag). Das tatsächliche Gehalt richtet sich nach deiner Berufserfahrung, Qualifikation und Einstufung und wird durch leistungsorientierte Boni ergänzt. Mit deiner Karriere bei EY entwickelt sich auch deine Vergütung weiter. Dabei gilt stets: „Equal Pay for Equal Work“.

Erstes telefonisches Gespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (ca. 5-10 Minuten)
Fachliches Gespräch mit dem jeweiligen Team
Je nach Position kann ein weiteres Gespräch oder eine Case Study folgen
Nach jedem Schritt erfolgt zeitnah Feedback. Abhängig von der Position kann der Prozess variieren.
Deine Ansprechperson:
Lina Storath
lina.storath@at.ey.com (Recruiting)

EY zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen in der Prüfung und Beratung. jd_text:
Consultant - Digital Government - Industries
Diegem, BE, 1831
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area within EY, and this with a huge potential for you. It offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Our competency teams are focused on helping our clients to improve their business performance and operational efficiency, whilst managing risk. We help clients by delivering assessment, transformation and assurance solutions in specialty areas, like finance, supply chain, strategic choices, risk management, cyber security and technology.
Shape the future with confidence.
The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits?
Are you early in your career and excited about the role technology can play in improving public services? Do you want to work on projects that create real impact for citizens, businesses and society.
Join EY’s
Digital Government
team and help governments and public institutions navigate their digital transformation journeys. From digital strategy and business analysis to data, process improvement and change management, you will contribute to projects that turn digital ambitions into tangible outcomes and create lasting public value.
As a
Consultant
, you will gain hands-on experience, work alongside experienced professionals and support initiatives that help public sector organizations become more efficient, future-ready and citizen-focused.
Your Key Responsibilities
As a Consultant, you will support project teams both operationally and analytically while receiving coaching from experienced colleagues.
This also includes:
Analyse processes, stakeholders, needs and dependencies.
Create presentations, analyses and reports.
Prepare and document workshops.
Gather, analyse and structure information.
Translate findings into recommendations and insights.
Support business analysis, data analysis and project management activities.
Quickly learn and apply new digital topics.
Gain exposure to digital transformation from a people, process and technology perspective.
Actively contribute to successful project delivery.
In addition, you will support public procurement initiatives and other go-to-market activities that enhance EY’s visibility and reputation in the public sector.
Your Profile
You have:
Master’s degree or equivalent experience.
Background in Public Management, Public Administration, Business Engineering, Business Economics, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, Digital Innovation or a related field.
Eager to step outside your comfort zone and make an impact in the Belgian public sector.
Curious about how technology can address societal challenges
Strong affinity with AI and genuine interest in applying new AI trends in a professional context.
Analytical, structured and eager to learn.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Collaborative and proactive team player.
Good knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; experience with Power BI, Confluence or similar tools is a plus.
Fluent professional Dutch; English and/or French are considered an advantage.
Note: The list above is a wishlist. If you cover around 80% of the elements listed, you might be a good candidate to become our future colleague.
What’s In It For You
EY Family
– you become part of the EY Family providing you with all the necessary skills, training and opportunities; enabling you to grow to your fullest potential.
Attractive remuneration package
- We offer an attractive remuneration package; including a company car and charging card, iPhone plus subscription, health insurance, pension plan, meal vouchers, and eco vouchers. Thanks to our flex plan it is possible to choose what you value most.
Mobility package
- You’ll be able to opt-in for the mobility budget. In return for giving up your (right to a) company car, you’ll receive a monthly budget from EY as compensation. This budget will allow you to use your employer-provided compensation for alternative transportation means or similar benefits, incl. reimbursement of housing costs (on condition you live within 10km of your main place of employment).
Flexible working arrangements
- We are proud of our flexible working arrangements. We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities. We offer flexible working hours and working from home multiple days per week is possible.
Inspiring work environment
- At EY we are dedicated to providing you with an inspiring work environment. A work environment that allows you to further develop your skills and enables you to fulfill your true potential.
Learning & personal growth
- You will benefit from an onboarding program, receive extensive training and will be coached by a counselor. We offer a clear career path tailored to your unique skills with necessary guidance.
Artificial Intelligence
– stay up to date with the latest AI trends through our extensive training opportunities and integrated AI systems. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in a smart and efficient way in your day-to-day work, while developing skills to identify, quantify and track value creation when integrating AI into client environments.
Fun
- By joining our EY- teams, you can participate in team activities, and companywide events and enjoy a drink during our monthly after-work drink.
Sustainability
- We have a fleet of hybrid and electric cars. Our flex plan makes it possible for you to choose the most sustainable option for you. You can also opt for a train subscription or lease a bike.
Diversity & Inclusion
- At EY we are passionate about the inclusion and support of individuals of all groups; we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.
Location
- All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and
have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided.
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

Consultant, Strategy and Execution - Deal Management (Montreal)
Montréal, Quebec, CA, H3A 0A8
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
EY-Parthenon is one of the largest global strategy consulting organizations. EY-Parthenon is Ernst & Young's global strategy consulting arm. We help CEOs and business leaders design and deliver transformative strategies across the entire enterprise, to help build long-term value to all stakeholders.
At EY-Parthenon, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY-Parthenon become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Competitive business today is all about making intelligent, informed decisions. As a Strategy and Execution Consultant within EY-Parthenon you will help make that happen. You will be an important part of our diversely talented, highly experienced team and work at the forefront of high-profile transactions and integration mandates. When you join our industry-leading team, you’ll be right at the heart of that challenge, working with leading business tools and methodologies to provide to some of the most sophisticated clients around.
Through a diversity of experiences from our strategy through execution capabilities, supplemented with world-class training, you’ll develop the technical skill sets and growth mindset to become the transformative business leader you want to be. At EY-Parthenon, you can make a meaningful impact, your way. It’s your career to build.
As an EY-Parthenon Consultant within our Strategy and Execution practice, you’ll participate as a valued member of project teams helping clients address their most pressing strategic challenges. Together with your team, you will play a vital role by supporting and executing strategies for transactions and developing experience across a range of different type of engagements including pre-deal (e.g., due diligence, operational and carve-out planning) and post-deal (e.g., integration planning, tracking, value creation) touching upon key functional areas, across a variety of industries.
Key responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to:
Integration strategy, planning, and execution by providing project management support, and executive communication
Carve-out or divestiture strategy, planning, and execution, supporting operating model design, and transaction services agreement development
Operational due diligence, stand-alone costing, one-time cost development, operating model design
Synergy/value realization identification, validation and tracking
Development of Transitional Services Agreements
Development of M&A and integration playbooks
Support client engagement teams execute integration or carve-out services
Support key client decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value
Assist in identifying risks and issues related to integration planning, timelines, and functional areas
You’ll be trained in key business concepts and analytical methods immediately upon joining the team and throughout your EY-Parthenon journey. You’ll also interact with C-suite clients, making this the perfect place to gain firsthand insights into how some of the most well-known brands in the world operate.
If you’re ready to build on your potential, develop as an EY-Parthenon Consultant, and join a growing team, this role is for you.
What we look for
You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.
You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
Qualifications:
Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA, CFA, PMP and CMC), or have achieved the necessary hours but have yet to receive the certification
3 years of of related work experience is preferred
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess complex situations and business problems to formulate potential solutions for clients
Experience in financial statement analysis, risk assessment, and process improvement is considered an asset
Effective organization and time management skills, with the ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements or scopes of work and deliver results under tight deadlines
Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to write reports and presentations in a clear and concise manner
Experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders is valued
Confident communicator to clients at all organization levels, including executive, VP, director, and operational management, with strong presentation delivery and
interpersonal skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
Proficiency with MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and MS Word
Ability to travel within Canada and the US (must be authorized to work in Canada)
This role involves interaction with clients operating nationally and globally. Bilingualism in both French and English is therefore a requirement of this role
Ideally, you will also have:
Experience in audit, assurance, or related fields is considered an asset
Previous M&A experience is considered an asset
Interest and passion for digital, technology, and new business building topics
What’s in it for you
Accelerate your technical capabilities and transformative leadership skills with future-focused courses and development programs.
Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally.
Bring out the best in yourself with continuous investment in your personal well-being and career development.
Develop your own personal purpose and help us create a positive ripple effect on our teams, our business, clients and society – building a better working world, together.
This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.
What we offer
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:
Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.
Inclusiveness at EY
Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.
Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at
https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with the highest ethical principles and regulatory requirements.
To all recruitment agencies: EY does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes submitted without a prior agreement or request from our hiring team will not be considered. EY is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

As a Senior Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution team, you play a key role in helping clients navigate complex transactions and transformations.
