In this role, you support decisions that directly impact business performance and long-term value, working with leading corporates and investors on high-impact, often large-scale transactions.
We work end-to-end across the transaction lifecycle. On the sell side, we help clients prepare and separate businesses, from defining the transaction perimeter and designing standalone operating models and costing to executing the carve-out. On the buy side, we work with clients to evaluate (carved-out) acquisition targets, define integration strategies, and realize synergies. Beyond the transaction, we continue to work alongside clients to realize change, challenge status quo, capture synergies, and deliver measurable improvements in performance.
You work directly with clients on carve-outs, integrations, and transformations by structuring complex topics, advising on key decisions, and ensuring plans are translated into tangible results.

Lead and execute in-depth analyses on business performance, cost structures, and operations, translating comingled data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Structure complex problems and translate them into clear, actionable solutions, guiding workstreams from initial hypothesis through to implementation

Build robust business cases for synergies, cost optimization, and broader value creation opportunities, and support their realization
Translate strategic priorities into concrete actions and drive their execution to deliver tangible results
Work closely with clients to guide decision-making, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum in fast-paced, high-impact environments
Support and develop junior team members through coaching, feedback, and hands-on guidance, helping them grow while ensuring long-term, high-quality delivery

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry: the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Within the FSO, our Business Transformation and Growth team helps organizations reimagine how they operate, compete, and grow. We work side by side with clients across the FSO, from the industry’s most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants spanning Insurance, Banking and Capital Markets, and Wealth and Asset Management. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges and building a financial services industry that is trusted and flourishing, then come join our dynamic FSO team!
Our Business Transformation and Growth team helps financial services clients improve and transform their life/annuity, group benefits, and retirement services businesses in areas such as operating model redesign, process improvement, technology enablement, organizational design, M&A due diligence, and post-merger integration as clients reimagine, modernize and disrupt how they succeed in the market and create long-term, sustainable value.
The opportunity
Advances in AI, cloud, and advanced analytics are resetting what organizations can do: faster onboarding / underwriting, elevated experiences, lower cost to serve, and more productive distribution.  We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Consultant to join EY engagement teams, deliver consulting services and develop business with our clients.
In this role, you will help our clients achieve their desired goals and business objectives. In return, you can expect to learn leading practices in business & technology transformation while solving a range of complex challenges using modern digital tools and methods. You will gain exposure in all areas of the value chain: product development, sales and distribution, new business and underwriting, service and policy administration, and claims.

Consistently deliver high-quality client services across a variety of engagements
Redesign and modernize core functions (e.g., sales, underwriting, new business, policy administration, claims)
Document current- and future-state operating models and business processes
Communicate complex issues clearly and build relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels
Monitor progress, manage risk, and keep key stakeholders informed on engagement progress and expected outcomes
Stay abreast of industry trends and apply in-depth domain knowledge and technical acumen to solve client problems
Present key findings to client / EY leadership
Develop a strong personal brand by building team assets and points of view (e.g., thought leadership, frameworks, benchmarks, accelerators) that translate industry trends into client solutions
Stay informed of and apply professional standards and firm policies
Contribute to proposals and business development, including client materials, pricing inputs, and follow-on scoping

Strong oral and written communication skills including executive presentation skills
Experience assessing and improving business processes, systems, and associated technologies
Understanding of financial services products and the operations processing lifecycle
Experience documenting operating models and business processes
Travel to client sites, as necessary
Ideally, you'll also have
Understanding / experience with life, annuity, or group product lines (e.g., fixed, indexed and variable annuities, term/whole/indexed/variable life insurance, group disability & dental)

Familiarity with core technology platforms (e.g., CRM, order entry, workflow, underwriting, policy administration, servicing and claims) and modernization of legacy platforms
Working knowledge of data, analytics, and AI applications across the insurance value chain
Knowledge of insurance regulatory and underwriting/suitability requirements and their operational implications
Experience with M&A due diligence, post-merger integration, or reinsurance and capital-efficiency initiatives

We're interested in passionate problem-solvers who want to shape the future of the insurance and retirement industry. If you bring curiosity about where life, annuity, retirement and group markets are heading, a bias for delivering measurable client impact, and the drive to grow into a transformation leader, this role is for you. You will work alongside senior leaders, build deep insurance and technology expertise, and take on increasing ownership of client outcomes.

Dublin 2, IE
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Full-Time – Permanent
About EY-Parthenon Strategy
EY-Parthenon Strategy is EY’s global strategy consultancy, with more than 9,700 professionals working across three areas of focus: corporate and business unit strategy, growth strategy, and commercial due diligence. In 2024, EY-Parthenon was ranked 6th in Vault’s Top 50 Consulting Firms to Work For.
At EY-Parthenon Strategy, we put our purpose — building a better working world — at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to using unconventional yet pragmatic thinking to deliver actionable strategies in order to help our clients navigate the ever-changing business landscape.
You will be a part of a collaborative team that applies the latest thinking, research, and analytics to help transform clients’ businesses and solve complex problems. Working at EY-Parthenon Strategy offers the opportunity to change how world-leading organisations do business.
We advise on a vast range of issues, such as core value propositions, competitive positioning, and growth strategies. EY-Parthenon Strategy employees enjoy unparalleled contact with influential and highly experienced professionals at clients organisations, across a multitude of sectors.
The below relates to applications for the EY-Parthenon Strategy Ireland team only. If you are looking to apply for Transaction Strategy & Execution or Turnaround & Restructuring Strategy, please visit the EY Careers pages to apply.
The opportunity
We are currently seeking applications at the Consultant level. This is a unique opportunity to work with a diverse set of clients to solve their most difficult and important challenges. In EY-Parthenon Strategy, we work alongside our clients to help them prepare for the future. EY-Parthenon has a flat structure which will allow you to become actively involved in many levels of client work.
The team adopts a methodical and collaborative approach with clients to jointly answer the key strategic questions they are faced with. Examples of the work you will be involved in include
Working with senior leaders at clients to help them develop their organisational strategy – including defining the organisation’s purpose, outlining its strategic objectives, identifying key customer segments, planning to enter new geographies, building new go-to-market approaches, mapping the capabilities required for success, and tracking performance.
Delivering commercial due diligence to support M&A transactions, on both the buy-side and the sell-side.
Conducting business development activities to win projects with potential clients.
Developing a community within the team by building initiatives, writing thought leadership, getting involved in recruitment, and supporting internal team activities.
Skills and attributes for success
Successful candidates are intellectually curious, passionate about solving complex problems, hardworking, driven, have an enthusiastic and approachable demeanour, and have an entrepreneurial mindset. We want people who are creative, great communicators, who collaborate well with others, and who have a desire to learn.
Some of the traits we are looking for
Ability to confidently handle ambiguity and break complex problems into their constituent parts.
Ability to adopt and effectively communicate a logical, structured thought process.
Demonstrable quantitative and qualitative analysis skills.
Excellent written communication skills.
Strong verbal communications skills, including experience presenting to senior audiences.
Ability to quickly build trusting relationships with people.
Enjoys working in a highly collaborative and fast-paced team environment.
A passion for learning and sharing knowledge.
Strong business acumen.
Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
Effective time management skills with an ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines.
An entrepreneurial mindset to help build our fast-growing team.
What working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:
Pension
Discounted health insurance
Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP
consultations for you and your family
The purchase of additional annual leave
Hybrid Working
Free Gym membership
Travel Pass
Maternity & Paternity leave
Bike to work Scheme
Recognition Awards
Cash incentives for referrals
Work Mobile
Tech MBA paid by EY
Wellness rooms available in some offices
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
Career Progression
When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Inclusion & Diversity
We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.
We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Connect to your Industry
Do you want to contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and ambitious digital programmes, helping our clients deliver outcomes that support national security?
We are proud of the impact we have with our Defence & Security clients, the strength of our relationships, and the variety of our skills and expertise that we bring to help them achieve their mission.
We’re growing our teams across all of Technology and Transformation. If you are cleared to SC or DV level and want to grow your career in this sector, we are very keen to hear from you.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values.

Connect to your opportunity
Are you passionate about building your career in complex, technology-enabled transformation programmes?
Our clients operate in an environment shaped by increasing complexity, rapid technological change and evolving social and economic challenges. They need multidisciplinary teams that combine clear thinking, effective delivery governance and human-centred, technology-enabled change to deliver outcomes with confidence.
Within Deloitte’s Human Capital practice, you will work as part of multidisciplinary teams supporting some of the most important and demanding programmes in Defence, Security and Justice. These programmes often sit at the intersection of operating model change, workforce transformation, digital capability, and large-scale technical delivery and adoption.
You will support the design and delivery of complex engagements, taking responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables with guidance from more experienced colleagues. You will work closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, build your understanding of delivery challenges and contribute practical ideas and high-quality outputs. As your capability develops, you may take ownership of broader deliverables or coordinate specific activities. You will build your skills in programme delivery, client engagement and technology-enabled transformation using Deloitte’s methods, tools and global capabilities.
Major Programmes Communities
Within Major Programmes, you’ll focus on working with clients across the South and South West of England.
Your role will allow you to:
Work alongside engineering and digital delivery teams, developing experience in areas such as product management, Scrum Master, DevOps or related delivery approaches.
Support effective project, programme or portfolio governance by producing accurate delivery artefacts, including plans, change information and workshop outputs.
Contribute to digital transformation engagements through activities such as operating model design and implementation, business analysis and scaled agile delivery.
Support PMO and programme controls activities, including progress reporting, financial tracking, planning, RAID management, and data analysis and visualisation.
Contribute to the mobilisation and delivery of large-scale technology-enabled transformations, including programme setup, governance and delivery planning.
Gather and analyse information on programme performance across scope, budget, risk, dependencies and outcomes, highlighting issues and supporting clear reporting.
Take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, working with business, technical and delivery colleagues to complete them to a high standard.
Build confidence working with clients, contribute effectively to meetings and support proposals and other business-development activities.
Share practical insight, reusable materials and lessons learned to support our propositions, delivery methods and industry perspectives.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
All applicants must hold UK security clearance for a minimum of SC level.
Essential:
Some practical experience of contributing to technology-enabled projects, programmes or transformation initiatives, gained in a professional, academic or comparable setting.
An interest in the Defence or Security environment and the ability to develop relevant sector knowledge quickly.
Ability to take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, seek guidance when needed and produce accurate, high-quality outputs.
Awareness of, or experience applying, at least one relevant delivery capability, such as project or programme management, PMO, business analysis, agile delivery, product management or engineering delivery.
Ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, clients and stakeholders, adapting your style to the audience and contributing confidently to discussions.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant information, recognise delivery risks or issues and present clear findings.
Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, respond positively to feedback and contribute to shared outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to organise your own work, manage priorities and adapt when requirements or delivery conditions change.
An interest in developing commercial awareness, including an understanding of delivery constraints, financial considerations, suppliers and how proposals support client relationships.
Connect to your business - Technology and Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Human Capital
People are what powers enterprise. That’s why we need to focus on the human experience in an ever-changing, digital world. We help clients utilise technology to support their workforce, organisation, and HR Transformations.
Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.
Connect with your colleagues
“The great culture, flexibility, and range of experiences that Deloitte offers are what sets this firm apart. In Human Capital, Deloitte is far ahead of any of our immediate competitors.” - Sophia, Technology & Transformation.
Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in Bristol with hybrid working.
At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.
Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.
We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.
Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and quality.

Technology Enablement, Procurement, Senior Associate - Assistant Manager
Singapore
Job Description
KPMG has a strong Digital Transformation team in this region, and we are assisting several clients with End-to-End business transformation initiatives incorporating Supply Chain & Procurement products such as COUPA, Jaggaer, o9, Ivalua and Zycus. Our practice is further expanding, and we are currently seeking an experienced Procurement Consultant with strong Procure-to-Pay (P2P) expertise and a proven track record in delivering end-to-end Ivalua implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be hands-on, able to manage client engagements independently, and bring deep knowledge of procurement processes, functional design, testing, and change management.
This position is based in Singapore.
Responsibilities:
Deliver comprehensive end-to-end Ivalua implementation projects for the P2P workstream
Apply strong functional knowledge of procurement, sourcing, contracting, supplier management, and invoicing processes to align with client requirements
Manage project workstreams independently, taking on roles such as Functional Design Lead, Testing Lead, Project Manager, and Change Management Support
Lead functional design workshops, including requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis
Create project documentation, including to-be process flows, business process documents, configuration workbooks, testing strategies, test scenarios, test scripts, and training materials
Lead and execute testing phases, including SIT, UAT, and Regression testing
Support change management activities and deliver end-user and supplier training
Collaborate closely with client stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, and suppliers to ensure successful adoption and business outcomes
Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and procurement best practices to deliver innovative solutions
Support integration activities with client ERPs such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday (preferred)
The ideal candidate should possess:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university (preferred)
Minimum 5+ years in supply chain consulting or relevant industry roles, with a proven track record of delivering successful projects and driving measurable business impact
Proven experience in end-to-end Ivalua implementation across multiple projects
Strong expertise in P2P functional processes
Hands-on experience in leading workshops, preparing documentation, and managing testing phases
Ability to independently manage client engagements and take on multiple roles
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
ERP integration experience (SAP, Oracle, Workday, etc.) is an advantage

Job Description
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.
How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognised as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.
The Team
This role sits within our Generalist team, working across Healthcare, Industrials, Education, Technology and Consumer.
- Broad exposure to different markets, business models and strategic challenges
- Strong focus on PE and transaction advisory, supporting investors across the deal cycle
- Regular interaction with leading investors and management teams
- Rapid development of experience across industries and investment contexts
The Role
- Associate Consultants play a key role within L.E.K. case teams, taking ownership of defined project modules and helping turn research and analysis into clear strategic insights.
- Working closely with Consultants, Managers and other members of the case team, Associate Consultants contribute to developing hypotheses, conducting and quality-checking research and analysis, and forming fact-based recommendations. The role provides significant exposure to a broad range of strategic and commercial questions, as well as opportunities to interact with clients.
- Locations: London, Paris or Munich
- Key responsibilities
- Lead defined workstreams or modules within a project, taking responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of assigned work
- Conduct primary and secondary research on markets, customers and competitors, drawing on public sources, databases, industry reports, client data and interviews
- Perform rigorous quantitative, strategic and financial analysis, including market sizing, competitor analysis, business planning and valuation
- Analyse and synthesise large volumes of information to identify key trends, insights and implications
- Work with case team members to translate research and analysis into clear conclusions and recommendations for clients
- Conduct customer, competitor and market interviews professionally and effectively
- Ensure analysis and data collection are accurate, well documented and supported by clear methodologies and sources
- Review and quality-check own work, taking responsibility for its accuracy and reliability
- Manage priorities and time effectively, meeting agreed deadlines and proactively flagging risks or bottlenecks to the case team
- Contribute positively to the wider team, including supporting and coaching more junior colleagues and new joiners
- Participate in professional development, recruiting and other firm activities as required
Who We Are Looking For
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work confidently with both quantitative and qualitative information
- Commitment to maintaining L.E.K.’s standards of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality at all times
- Intellectual curiosity, resourcefulness and creativity in identifying information and approaching complex problems
- Ability to synthesise complex or large amounts of information into clear, practical insights
- Strong attention to detail, with ownership of the accuracy and quality of their work
- Organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines effectively
- Clear and professional communication with colleagues, clients and external interviewees
- Collaborative approach, contributing positively to a high-performing team

Description de l'entreprise
Spécialiste du Leadership Advisory au sein du groupe de Conseil SIA, Uside accompagne, depuis 30 ans, les dirigeants à relever les défis culturels et humains liés au développement et aux transformations stratégiques de leurs entreprises.
Fondé par le psychiatre Eric Albert, fort d’une expertise pluridisciplinaire (psychologie, sociologie des organisations, science des comportements…), Uside accompagne les 2/3 des entreprises du CAC 40 dans la résolution de problématiques complexes : gagner en efficacité collective, identifier et développer les Talents, améliorer le bien-être au travail.
Réunissant plus de 40 consultants, coachs et psychologues, la singularité de Uside réside dans sa capacité à concevoir des réponses qui allient exigence et sur-mesure, s’adresser tant aux managers qu’aux dirigeants, proposer une approche unique centrée sur les comportements des acteurs de l’entreprise.

Description du poste
Nous recherchons un consultant pour accompagner le développement du Pôle Efficacité collective, qui intervient dans l’accompagnement des transformations culturelles, le coaching d’équipes de direction, ou encore la conception de programmes de formation aux soft skills…
Au sein de l’équipe, le consultant senior a pour vocation :
- De contribuer aux missions du Pôle Efficacité Collective :
- En appui du Directeur de mission, en matière de gestion de projets, préparation de séminaires et ateliers, conception de supports d’animation…
- En assurant le suivi (prise de notes, compte rendu, analyse, synthèse, proposition, plan d’action…) des interventions clients.
- D’apporter son appui au développement en concevant et rédigeant des propositions commerciales et réponses à appels d'offres, en coordination avec les autres membres de l’équipe.
- En contribuant au Knowledge Management du cabinet : formalisation et enrichissement des méthodologies et savoir-faire du cabinet au fil des missions et projets menés.

Qualifications
Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce, de Sciences Po ou d’une grande université, vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou en management. Vous avez démontré une réelle capacité à travailler en équipe dans un environnement exigeant, en faisant preuve de rigueur et d’autonomie. Vous possédez une forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse, une aisance rédactionnelle ainsi qu’une grande clarté dans la communication. Réactif(ve), doté(e) d’une intelligence situationnelle développée et d’un excellent relationnel, vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux humains au sein des entreprises. Vous parlez anglais couramment et maîtrisez parfaitement PowerPoint.

Description du poste
Sia compte en France plus de 300 consultants dans le pôle data, répartis dans plusieurs business units. La BU AI & Marketing, qui compte une trentaine de consultant(e)s, intervient au carrefour de l'analytique avancée, du machine learning et des problématiques marketing (client, produit, prix et réseau de ventes). Elle combine des compétences techniques poussées avec une compréhension fine des enjeux métier, afin d'aider ses clients à prendre de meilleures décisions.
Pour accompagner son développement, la BU AI & Marketing recrute un(e) consultant(e) Data Scientist avec une forte appétence pour les sujets et enjeux Marketing, Client et Produit.
Vous intervenez chez nos clients (Luxe, Retail, Énergie et Banque) pour répondre à leurs enjeux data et IA les plus stratégiques, à travers différents sujets : 
Analytics & Business Intelligence 
- Réaliser des analyses avancées pour accompagner les décisions stratégiques des directions métier (offre, assortiment, performance, omnicanalité...).
- Concevoir des solutions de Business Intelligence et des outils self-service en mobilisant des compétences en data engineering et analytics. 
IA & Machine Learning 
- Concevoir des modèles de Machine Learning pour la prédiction, la segmentation, la recommandation et la prévision, afin d'optimiser les performances marketing et commerciales.
- Développer des cas d'usage en IA et IA générative pour l'analyse de données et de contenus (NLP, Marketing Mix Modelling, recommandations, personnalisation...).
- Transformer les données en leviers de performance en concevant des solutions adaptées aux enjeux métier et à l'expérience client. 
Conseil & Communication 
- Accompagner des interlocuteurs non techniques (directeurs Marketing, Client, Produit) en vulgarisant vos analyses et en formulant des recommandations avec impact.
- Vulgariser vos analyses et formuler des recommandations à impact tout en développant votre autonomie 
Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s'articule autour des axes suivants : 
- Contribuer au développement de nos offres en participant aux formations, groupes de travail, publications et à la production de supports internes et externes. 
- Faire vivre l'expertise Data Science & IA grâce à une veille active sur les publications de recherche (arXiv, Google DeepMind, papers académiques…) et à l'expérimentation de nouveaux outils et modèles (LLMs, nouvelles architectures ML, bibliothèques Python…). 
- Animer la communauté Data Science en contribuant aux labs thématiques (GenAI, Computer Vision, Time Series, Data Marketing) et en partageant vos travaux et retours d'expérience (write-ups, présentations internes…). 
Quelques exemples de missions : 
- Détection et classification automatique de besoins parmi des utilisateurs : Identification des grands thèmes et des besoins précis à partir d’échanges en texte libre provenant de diverses sources (sondages, échange de mails, …) via IA générative, traitement NLP et clustering. 
- Prévision de ventes pour optimiser l’assortiment de nouveaux produits en magasin : Développement d’un modèle de machine learning pour estimer le potentiel de vente de nouveaux produits de luxe dans chaque magasin du réseau afin de fournir des recommandations d’assortiments de produits en magasins. 
- Analyse des comportements clients pour une maison de luxe : Approfondir la connaissance client et réaliser une segmentation de ces derniers. L’objectif est d’identifier des profils de clients homogènes à l’aide des techniques de clustering et trouver les attributs qui les caractérisent et leurs sont propres, afin de mieux cibler les actions marketing et optimiser la stratégie commerciale de l'entreprise.

Qualifications
Diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou d'une formation de haut niveau en analyse de données, statistiques ou mathématiques appliquées et marketing, avec 0 à 3 ans d'expérience en data science, voici ce que nous attendons de vous : 
Technique 
- Maîtrise de Python, SQL et de la modélisation de données.
- Solides connaissances en Machine Learning et IA générative (apprentissage supervisé, non supervisé, clustering...).
- Une première expérience des approches NLP et/ou GenAI est un plus. 
Compétence métier / business 
- Forte orientation métier : capacité à comprendre les enjeux marketing et à concevoir des solutions data adaptées.
- Excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale, à l'aise pour présenter vos analyses et recommandations à un top management. 
Atouts supplémentaires appréciés 
- Connaissance d'un environnement Cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure).
- Compréhension des enjeux métier dans les secteurs du luxe, de la grande consommation, de l'énergie, de la banque et de l'assurance. 
- Expérience en analyse de données dans un contexte marketing.
- Maîtrise des outils de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik…) et de visualisation (dash, plotly). 
Vous disposez d'une appétence pour les enjeux data et IA appliqués aux problématiques marketing, d'une capacité de monter en compétences rapidement et êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'accompagner nos clients à en saisir les opportunités. 
Vous êtes curieux(se), aimez travailler en équipe et êtes reconnu(e) pour votre sens de l'analyse. Vous partagez nos valeurs : excellence, entrepreneuriat, innovation, partage, bienveillance et équilibre vie personnelle/vie professionnelle. Vous parlez français et anglais couramment dans un contexte professionnel.
Alors, rejoignez-nous !

Informations supplémentaires
Rejoindre Sia c’est : 
- Travailler sur des missions à fort impact dans des secteurs d’activités variés (énergie, luxe, transport, finance…), 
- Développer ses compétences grâce à un large choix de formations et certifications en data (SQL, GCP, IA générative, Marketing Mix Modelling, soft skills, prise de parole…)
- Travailler dans une communauté de 300 data scientists en France, source d'émulation et d'apprentissage continu. 
- Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, entre projets R&D à forte valeur ajoutée et partages d'expertise via des publications : https://sia-ai.medium.com/

This role sits within L.E.K.’s Industrials team, one of our fastest-growing practices across Europe. The team works with leading corporates and investors on the major trends reshaping industry, from the energy transition, electrification and sustainable infrastructure to AI, automation, digitalisation and evolving global supply chains. - Collaborative approach, contributing positively to a high-performing team

- Degree-level education, with a strong academic track record

jd_text:
Company Description
About Sia
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
Strategy & Management Consulting
Sia’s Strategy & Management Consulting global footprint and expertise in more than 40 sectors and services allow us to enhance our clients' businesses worldwide. We guide their projects and initiatives in strategy, business transformation, IT & digital strategy.
Financial Institutions have drastically changed over the last decade, driven by increased regulatory constraints, diverse competition inside and beyond traditional banking organizations, and emerging technologies reshaping long-standing ecosystems. Sia’s Financial Services Business Unit provides a comprehensive suite of core capabilities designed to address the diverse and evolving needs of our clients, enabling them to navigate complex challenges, seize new opportunities, and achieve their strategic objectives in an increasingly competitive and dynamic business environment.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly motivated Consultant to join our Financial Services Consulting practice as a Forward Deployed Business Analyst (FDBA). Whether your expertise lies in wealth and asset management, capital markets, corporate banking, risk and compliance or other areas in financial services, we want to hear from you. 
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role. As a FDBA, you will be embedded with client teams to own business outcomes, not just document requirements. You will leverage data, analytics and AI as a core part of your workflow to move faster, think deeper , and deliver smarter solutions and meaningful transformation across financial services organizations. 
You will act as a strategic advisor, AI operator , and execution partner, using AI to eliminate administrative work and focus your time on enhanced decision making, problem-solving, stakeholder alignment, operational efficiency and solution design. 
Responsibilities:
- AI-Enabled Consulting Delivery: Apply traditional consulting tools and emerging AI-enabled, no-code, low-code, automation, and analytics platforms to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, process mapping, stakeholder alignment, and delivery execution while including defining agent responsibilities, decision boundaries, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop controls to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant operation within financial services environments. 
- Client Engagement & Delivery: Work directly with client business, operations, product, data, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, operational challenges, technical constraints, stakeholder priorities, and desired business outcomes. 
- Strategic Problem Solving: Assess current-state processes, systems, data flows, risks, dependencies, and pain points to identify root causes, evaluate business impacts, and help define the design and implementation of strategic initiatives that incorporate both traditional and AI-enabled strategic solutions (e.g., operating model transformation, system implementations, process optimization) 
- Technical Business Analysis: Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, data requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and solution documentation that bridge business stakeholders and technical delivery teams with the support of internal and client-approved AI solutions. 
- Solution Design & Implementation Support: Partner with product owners, engineers, architects, data teams, and client stakeholders to support solution design system implementation, workflow optimization, integration planning, UAT, validation, and implementation readiness across front, middle, and back-office platforms including .targeted use cases of AI- or agent-enabled solutions. 
- Workstream Ownership & Execution: Own assigned tasks and deliverables by managing timelines, tracking risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies, proactively communicating progress, and helping drive initiatives from analysis through execution. 
- Client-Ready Communication & Deliverables: Prepare structured, accurate, and polished materials, including presentations, executive summaries, business cases, impact assessments, process documentation, status reports, meeting outputs, and stakeholder communications for internal teams, client stakeholders, and senior leaders. 
- Internal Firm Support: Support proposals and business development initiatives, including client presentations and thought leadership, contributing perspectives on digital, data, and AI trends within financial services.

Qualifications
These qualifications are intended to reflect what may help someone succeed as a Consultant at Sia. We recognize that candidates may not meet every qualification listed, and we encourage you to apply if you are excited about the role, eager to learn, and believe you can contribute to our teams and clients. 
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, AI Engineering & Computing, Computer Science, Data Science, Financial Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.

jd_text:
Company Description
We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.
We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. 
Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.
PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life

Job Description
This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses.
As a Product Strategist, you'll help clients identify which problems are worth solving and shape products that deliver measurable value. Working alongside AI Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll take opportunities from discovery through adoption, combining deep business understanding with a practical view of what technology can achieve. The person defining the product is also accountable for whether it gets used, which means you'll stay close to the outcome long after launch.
This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. AI agents are changing how products are built, but they cannot decide what should be built in the first place. You'll work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help clients move from broad ambitions to solutions that create lasting impact.
As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to:
- Lead discovery with clients to understand how work gets done, where value is being lost, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.
- Define product requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and success measures that guide delivery and enable measurable outcomes.
- Translate business challenges into products, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent workflows that people will trust and adopt.
- Shape how AI capabilities are applied, including what should be automated, where human oversight is required, and how success should be evaluated.
- Drive adoption by aligning stakeholders, supporting change, and helping clients redesign processes where necessary to realize value.
- Create reusable approaches, assets, and industry insights that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and offerings we take to market.

Qualifications
You have a track record of defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions that create measurable business outcomes. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work.
To be successful, you'll have:
Product and strategy foundations
- Experience in product management, product strategy, consulting, or a similar role focused on defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions.
- Experience leading discovery, shaping product direction, and translating complex business challenges into actionable plans.
- Experience building business cases, defining success measures, and demonstrating value realization.
Industry and AI understanding
- Deep expertise in at least one industry sector, with the ability to quickly establish credibility with both operational and executive stakeholders.
- Working knowledge of AI-enabled products, including agents, retrieval approaches, automation, and the opportunities and limitations of modern AI systems.
- Experience evaluating competing opportunities and making informed decisions about where technology can create the greatest impact.
Enterprise delivery
- Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions from concept through implementation and adoption.
- Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions across multiple levels of an organization.
- Commercial judgment and the ability to balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints.
Ideally, you'll also bring:
- Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or a leadership role within your industry.
- Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries.
- Experience with change management, operating model design, process transformation, or driving adoption of new technologies.
- Experience using data, analytics, AI tools, SQL, Python, or similar approaches to support decision-making and product strategy.

Additional Information
Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site

Job Description
Help shape the future of health
Health and life sciences (HLS) organizations are at the heart of a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. Pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and healthcare organizations must respond to changing patient expectations, scientific advances, digital innovation, and increasing pressure to deliver better outcomes more efficiently. 
At PA, our Operating Model team helps these organizations translate strategy into action by designing operating models, organizational structures, governance, capabilities, and ways of working that enable innovation, growth, and lasting impact. Combining business design, transformation, technology, and human-centered thinking, we help clients build organizations that are ready for the future of health.
What you'll do
As a Health & Life Sciences Operating Model Consultant, you'll work alongside multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges and help HLS clients transform how their organizations operate. You'll utilize your scientific background to contribute to high-profile transformations while continuing to develope your subject matter expertise in health and life sciences operating design and business transformation. Our OpModel Consultants are responsible for:
- Designing future-state operating models, including organizational structures, governance, capabilities, and ways of working.
- Analyzing complex business challenges and developing practical recommendations, business cases, and transformation roadmaps.
- Facilitating stakeholder discussions and workshops, working with clients from operational teams to executive leadership.
- Assessing organizational capabilities, operating models, and ways of working to identify opportunities for improved performance and transformation.
What you’ll gain
- Exposure to complex, high-impact client challenges across the health and life sciences sector.
- Opportunities to work alongside experts in healthcare, life sciences, strategy, transformation, technology, and innovation.
- A structured development pathway focused on business and operating model design.
- The opportunity to help shape our growing team while developing expertise across pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and broader healthcare organizations.
Learn more about our Operating Model team and the work we do in Health & Life Sciences on our website.

Qualifications
What we’re looking for
Successful candidates will come from consulting, healthcare, life sciences, transformation, business analysis, organizational design, or strategy backgrounds.
- You have at minimum 2+ years of professional experience in consulting, health and life sciences, transformation, or a related industry role. We’re open to early-career professionals and career transitioners, but this is not an entry-level position.
- You’ve supported clinical, R&D, medical, regulatory, commercial, or enterprise transformation initiatives within pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, or healthcare organizations. You understand the scientific processes behind clients challenges and our solutions. 
- You possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. You consistently synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and insights.
- You’re known to be proactive and have a desire to solve difficult challenges with creativity and structure.
Experience in the following areas is a key indicator that you’ll be a strong match for our team:
- Pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, and patient-centered operating models and organizational design
- Clinical development, R&D, or commercial transformation
- Governance, capability, and process design
- Enterprise and technology-enabled transformation
- Change delivery, product ownership, or agile ways of working

Additional Information
Hybrid working: Our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site

jd_text:
Job Description
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.
 How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognised as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.
The Team
This role sits within L.E.K.’s Industrials team, one of our fastest-growing practices across Europe. The team works with leading corporates and investors on the major trends reshaping industry, from the energy transition, electrification and sustainable infrastructure to AI, automation, digitalisation and evolving global supply chains. Our work spans Building & Construction, Industrial Equipment & Technology, and Energy & Environment, offering exposure to a broad range of businesses, markets and strategic challenges.
As the practice continues to grow across Europe, we are expanding both our client base and our capabilities across strategy, M&A, operations and supply chain, pricing, and digital, data & analytics. Team members work collaboratively across offices and have the opportunity to build deep sector expertise while contributing to the continued growth and development of the Industrials practice.
The Role
Consultants play a central role within L.E.K. case teams, shaping the approach to client problems and translating analysis into clear, practical recommendations. They act as an important link between senior team members, junior colleagues and clients, helping to ensure that project work is delivered to a consistently high standard.
Working closely with Managers, Principals and Partners, Consultants lead workstreams, identify key client issues, structuring and managing analysis and contributing to the development of practical, evidence-based recommendations, while managing the day-to-day work of Associates.
Location: London
Key responsibilities
- Define the client’s key business issues, priorities and the critical questions to answer
- Structure and lead workstreams across market, customer, competitor, financial and strategic analysis
- Guide the team in gathering, interpreting and synthesising qualitative and quantitative information
- Review analysis for accuracy, commercial relevance and focus on the core questions
- Translate findings into clear conclusions, recommendations and implications
- Manage the day-to-day work of Associates: allocating tasks, setting expectations and reviewing outputs
- Coach and develop junior team members through regular guidance and feedback
- Manage routine client interactions and build strong relationships with stakeholders
- Contribute to client meetings, workshops and presentations
- Oversee high-quality deliverables, including presentations, models and written outputs
- Flag emerging insights, risks and bottlenecks early, and escalate significant decisions to senior team members
Who We Are Looking For
- Strong experience in strategy consulting, transaction or M&A advisory
- Excellent structured problem-solving and analytical skills
- Ability to quickly identify and prioritise the most important business issues
- Comfort leading strategic, commercial and financial analysis
- Ability to manage workstreams independently while staying aligned with senior team members
- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly
- Confidence engaging with clients and a range of stakeholders
- Ability to manage, coach and develop junior colleagues
- Strong commercial judgement, with a focus on practical recommendations
- Highly organised and proactive, with strong attention to detail
- Professionalism, sound judgement, integrity and high ethical standards

Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network I Areas of Work: Digital Thread and Connected Twins | Level: Analyst / Consultant | Location: Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata | Overall Relevant Exp: 2-5 years
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .
Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
· Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
· Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.
· Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
· Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.
· Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
· Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
· Strong analytical skills to reach clear-cut, methodical solutions
· Experience working with low-code/no-code or agentic orchestration platforms

The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .
Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
· Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
· Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.
· Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
· Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.
· Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
· Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

jd_text:
Join Accenture CEO Advisory’s Commodity Markets practice as a Strategy Analyst and help senior leaders address complex questions involving enterprise direction, portfolio choices, investment priorities, market opportunity, and operating model readiness. You will work with multidisciplinary and cross-border teams to develop practical, evidence-based recommendations that can withstand execution realities.
The role offers exposure to assignments across Southeast Asia and the broader global practice, with opportunities to build expertise in energy, commodities, trading, industrial markets, analytics, and AI-enabled strategy consulting.
Key Responsibilities
· Contribute to client workstreams by structuring business questions, testing hypotheses, and identifying value-creation opportunities under the guidance of experienced team members.
· Conduct market, competitor, regulatory, operational, and financial research, and translate findings into clear strategic insights.
· Develop quantitative and qualitative analyses, including market assessments, business cases, valuation support, scenario analysis, and commercial or portfolio evaluations.
· Support interviews and workshops, synthesize stakeholder input, and prepare concise presentations and recommendations for senior audiences.
· Work across corporate and portfolio strategy, energy transition positioning, market liberalisation, trading and risk capability, operating model design, commercial optimisation, and investment analysis.
· Collaborate with teams in Singapore, Southeast Asia, and the global Commodity Markets practice to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.
· Use GenAI, analytics, and digital tools responsibly to accelerate research and analysis, while remaining accountable for accuracy, quality, confidentiality, and professional judgement.
· Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, reusable assets, and knowledge-building activities across Commodity Markets and CEO Advisory.
Required Qualifications
· Currently in the final year of an undergraduate or master’s degree, or have up to two years of full-time work experience after graduation.
· Demonstrated critical, creative, and strategic thinking, with evidence of solving complex problems in a structured way through academic, internship, or professional work.
· Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with an interest in business, technology, markets, and strategy.
· Effective relationship-building and teamwork skills, with the confidence to contribute to interviews, workshops, and presentations.
· Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
· Exposure to statistics, data analytics, visualiation, or programming. Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, R, Python, Julia, SQL, or comparable tools is beneficial.
· Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, required to prepare client deliverables and collaborate with regional and global stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
· Exposure to commodity markets, trading, risk management, energy, investment analysis, or asset valuation.
· Experience combining AI-enabled approaches with quantitative modelling, research, or insight generation.
· International study, internship, or work experience.
· Familiarity with financial modelling, market forecasting, commercial assessment, or strategic business analysis.
Working Arrangements
· Opportunity to travel across Southeast Asia and, where global staffing requires, to other locations.
· Flexible working arrangements, with client-site presence when required by the engagement.
Why Join Us
· Build a career in a fast-paced strategy practice with transparent development opportunities, continuous coaching, and early responsibility.
· Work alongside strategy, industry, data, AI, and technology specialists addressing complex business challenges.
· Access the Commodity Markets global staffing network for cross-border and cross-industry project experience.
About the Company / Team
We work with one shared purpose: to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Every day, more than 775,000 of us help our stakeholders continuously reinvent. Together, we drive positive change and deliver value to our clients, partners, shareholders, communities, and each other.
We believe that delivering value requires innovation, and innovation thrives in an inclusive and diverse environment. We actively foster a workplace free from bias, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is respected and empowered to do their best work.
At Accenture, we see well-being holistically, supporting our people's physical, mental, and financial health. We also provide opportunities to keep skills relevant through certifications, learning, and diverse work experiences. We're proud to be consistently recognized as one of the World's Best Workplaces™.
Join Accenture to work at the heart of change.
Visit us at www.accenture.com.

ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. Insights & Analytics
ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
The role
A hands-on build-and-analyze role. You own modules within AI-enabled analytics products and independently deliver core commercial analytics workstreams for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 50/50 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You work under a Consultant, guide Associates on your modules, and interact directly with client analysts and product owners.
This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. You will be staffed across build and analytics work for the same client depending on demand. Both halves are required.
What You’ll Do
· AI & analytics engineering (~50%)
· Build and maintain pipeline components on Databricks: Delta transformations, metric views, signal-detection logic, LLM narrative steps, app-facing data contracts.
· Implement agent tools, prompts and context assets on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent); write the unit and regression tests that go with them.
· Run evaluation harnesses: score LLM outputs against rubrics, triage failures, log defects, propose fixes.
· Implement data-layer guardrails (governed tables, scope-controlling joins) and KPI canonicalization in code.
· Support SIT/UAT: test cases, evidence capture, defect lifecycle in JIRA. Core commercial analytics (~50%)
· Deliver analyses across client functions — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, enterprise operations — under Consultant direction, from data pull to insight.
· Apply the appropriate method — descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, forecasting basics, test-and-control — and explain why it fits.
· Work hands-on with varied data: syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer, operational and financial data.
· QC your own work — reconciliation to source, benchmark and sanity checks — and turn analysis into clear slides and written summaries for client review. Team
· Guide 1–2 Associates on module-level work; review their code and outputs.
· Own status and blockers for your modules; escalate early.
What You’ll Bring
· Bachelor's or master's degree required in any discipline with strong record of academic success in quantitative and analytic coursework such as operations research, applied mathematics, management science, data science, statistics, econometrics or engineering.
· 2-5 years of relevant post-collegiate job experience. A PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience.
· SQL — strong. Window functions, cohort logic, joins across large tables.
· Python — strong. pandas/PySpark, functions and modules, tests, Git.
· LLM application hands-on — Prompt and context engineering, RAG or tool calling; at least one application built end to end with a documented evaluation approach. Agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph) a plus.
· Applied analytics — translating business questions into analysis with QC: descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, test-and-control, forecasting basics. Life-sciences or healthcare data experience preferred — any function; exposure to real-world data (claims, EHR), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
· Clear written summaries and slides; comfortable presenting your own work to clients.
· Delivers modules end to end; asks the right questions early.
· Fluency in English
· Client-first mentality
· Intense work ethic
· Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach How you’ll grow:
· Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
· Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
· Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions
Perks & Benefits:
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India , visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS .
Hybrid working model:
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
Travel:
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
