jd_text:
About the Role
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations navigate complexity, drive reinvention, and create sustainable value.
The Role will be part of Macro Foresight - an Accenture's CEO Advisory business. We work with CEOs and boards on enterprise-wide strategy and reinvention, helping them perform, protect, and grow. Within that, we are the team that anticipates disruption and volatility: we help clients read the external environment - economic, geopolitical, and financial - and build long-term strategies for competitiveness and resilience. Our footprint is global, with hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia.
In the past two years we've helped leaders respond to the highest US tariffs in a century, energy and supply shocks around the Strait of Hormuz, two-speed economies, and the reordering of global trade around industrial policy and AI.
What we do
The work we deliver for client’s centers on a set of CEO- and board-level offerings:
· Economic and geopolitical impact assessments. AI-accelerated analysis of how macro and geopolitical shifts affect a business, a market, or a major investment.
· Scenario planning and wargaming. AI-enabled planning and table-top wargaming that test a strategy against a range of possible futures.
· Decision intelligence. Enterprise-wide decision support that reaches beyond macro and geopolitics into portfolio strategy, competition, consumer trends, and business performance.
· Strategic foresight and long-range planning. Structured futures assessments and long-range portfolio planning.
· Enterprise resilience assessments. CEO- and board-level diagnostics that measure and strengthen an organization's resilience to shocks.
· Foresight capability enablement. Helping clients build their own capability across people, process, and technology.
The people we hire
We hire for a few different profiles, and many people here bring more than one:
· Economists and geopolitical experts who read the real economy, financial and commodity markets, and the interplay of policy, trade, and security, and apply it to a client's business context.
· Strategists who translate complex analysis into recommendations a leadership team can act on.
· Entrepreneurial people who grow teams and develop those who join after them.
· AI engineers who code, build models, and put large language models and AI agents to work. We're actively hiring for this.
· People who work well with ambiguity , set their own direction, and want to help build new offerings like scenario planning, wargaming, and foresight.
Based in our Singapore hub, you'll work on the questions reshaping the Asia Pacific region: supply-chain reconfiguration, China's changing role, geopolitical tensions, and the new industrial forces driving growth in the region. You'll help multinationals, regional companies, government-linked entities, and investors turn that uncertainty into practical strategy and stronger resilience.
What you'll be doing
· Deliver client engagements. Own a workstream from the first framing of the question through to the recommendation, and stay with it as the client acts on it.
· Work as part of a team. Deliver on small engagement teams, learn from senior colleagues, and help develop those who join after you.
· Build the analysis behind the advice. Create the models, scenarios, dashboards, and data pipelines that turn raw data into clear answers.
· Put AI to work. Use large language models and AI agents to accelerate monitoring, research, and scenario analysis on live projects.
· Help build our offerings and platform. Work with Accenture's AI engineering teams to turn scenario planning, wargaming, and decision intelligence into productized, AI-enabled services, and to develop our AI Foresight platform.
· Sharpen our thinking between engagements. Alongside the client work, contribute to our monthly Macro Briefs and points of view, with the chance over time to publish under your own name.
What we're looking for
· At least 2 years delivering strategy, economics, or advisory work in consulting, corporate development, investment, or research. Including:
· A track record of delivering on client work : running a workstream in a team, hitting deadlines, and holding your own with a client.
· The ability to turn analysis into a decision , drawing out what macro and company data mean for a client's business.
· Demonstrated experience using AI tools to redesign and accelerate workflows, improve research and analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance project delivery.
· A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience .
What will make you stand out
· A graduate degree in economics, finance, public policy, international relations, or management (or an MBA), or an advanced quantitative, computational, data science, or engineering background.
· Curiosity about macro and geopolitics , with a strong grasp of how the real economy connects to markets, sectors, and regions
· Experience with our core offerings: scenario planning, wargaming, or foresight .
· AI and engineering depth , with priority given to developing AI-enabled analytical solutions: coding in Python and/or R, building models, dashboards, or data pipelines, and applying LLMs and AI agents to analytical workflows .
· Experience communicating with and advising C-suite or board audiences, or depth in a specific industry or region's political economy.
· Familiarity with tools like Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau , or econometrics packages such as Stata or EViews.
The practical details
· Fluency in English is required for this role.
· Proficiency in a regional language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, or Bahasa Indonesia ) is nice to have
Accenture is committed to equal employment opportunity and to building a diverse, inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and consider them without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Description
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
The A&M Global Transaction Advisory Group (“GTAG”) is comprised of former Big Four CPAs and CAs who provide private equity and corporate clients buy side and sell side financial accounting due diligence. GTAG professionals actively engage in assessing a target’s quality of earnings, analyzing cash flows, reviewing working capital, identifying key business drivers, reviewing forecasts, and conducting comprehensive discussions with management and their advisors. GTAG professionals routinely team with the firm’s operational, tax, commercial, and information technology professionals to deliver a truly integrated solution to clients.
How you will contribute
· Assist with core financial due diligence, helping to identify key risks and potential deal breakers, assess the strengths and weaknesses of the business against industry benchmarks, and assist with the evaluation of the potential transaction in the context of their clients’ investment strategy.
· Analyse detailed financial statement information including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and key operational data. Synthesize and convert the data into meaningful information that is used to drive discussions with target management and drive observations and conclusions.
· Assess the quality of the target company's reported earnings, net assets and cash flows.
· After an investigative analysis, assist in the construction of deal-oriented reports and presentations for clients that highlight the key financial, commercial and other findings facing investments and the drivers behind maintainable profits and cash flows. Assist the team in further articulating how such findings should be incorporated into the client's valuation and sale / purchase agreement and provide other negotiating points.
· Participate in meetings and conference calls with target company management and with client personnel and will serve as an additional point of contact for client personnel with respect to day-to-day execution matters.
· Displays the ability to manage and prioritize assigned responsibilities and proactively consults with superiors.
· Ability to assist with multiple chargeable and non-chargeable projects of varying size and complexity.
· Possesses the ability to self-review and critique project databooks.
· Possesses appropriate report writing skills in order to assist the engagement team in writing full DD report.
· Ability to assist the engagement team in Quality of Earnings, P&L and Working Capital analysis with guidance from the engagement manager.
· Able to assist the engagement manager with engagement issues (e.g., billing, status updates, scope changes) including preparation of scope of procedures, request lists, etc.
· Can effectively assist engagement managers with day-to-day client interaction on deals.
· Works with engagement manager to develop and propose creative solutions to engagement and transaction risks.
· Consistently displays desire to take on more responsibility.
· Gathers applicable conflict check information and coordinates with Managing Directors to set up engagement codes and other engagement requirements.
Qualifications
· Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting and/or related major
· CPA or CA certification preferred
· Big Four experience required
· Fluent in English, and either one of the following languages is preferred: Mandarin Chinese, Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog or Vietnamese.
· Ability to travel within the region (where practical and possible)
· Solid hands-on experience working in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, or Vietnam (in country), preferably with one of the Big Four accounting firms.
· Strong excel and power point skills required. Experience with data analytics and visualization software (i.e., Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) strongly preferred.
· The ideal candidate for the Senior Associate position will have at least 2 years of audit experience at a Big Four accounting firm as well as a preferred minimum of 2 years of experience in a financial accounting due diligence group.
· The ideal candidate for the Associate position will have at least 2 years of audit experience at a Big Four accounting firm.
· The successful candidate will be ranked a Top Performer in his or her peer group and furthermore, driven to success, a self-starter, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills. The individual will be insightful, decisive, a critical thinker, and commercial. Further, the individual will be able to work well on teams however will develop the knowledge and maturity to work with our clients independently.
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to articulate to senior members of target management, client representatives and colleagues
· Highly analytical mind-set
· Strong project management skills
· Deep accounting skills including a working knowledge of IFRS
· Team-oriented personality
· Professional in style and demeanor/exercises good judgment
· Motivated and effective in a fast-paced culture
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

The Resilient & Sustainable Value Chain Practice is a part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting and enables greater resiliency, sustainability and efficiency with end-to-end capabilities. We help organizations embed sustainability into every aspect of their supply chain to enable them to unlock greater value through responsible transformations.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in Sustainable Value Chain , where you will get an opportunity to advise and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. We also work with global organizations such as the World Economic Forum , the United Nations Global Compact and World Business Council for Sustainable Development . As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the areas you will consult clients on:
· Resilient Supply Chain Strategy: Work closely with clients to assess vulnerabilities across their value chains and co-develop end-to-end resilience and sustainability strategies tailored to their business context.
· Sustainable Value Creation: Help clients build supply chain operating models that are economically efficient while embedding environmental and social responsibility across procurement, operations, and logistics.
· Supply Chain Transformation Roadmaps: Develop implementation road maps for resilient and sustainable supply chains, leveraging data-driven insights across themes such as circular economy, supply chain decarbonization, traceability, and responsible sourcing.
· Industry Partner Alliances: Work with notable organizations like UN, WEF, FICCI and prominent business leaders to shape sustainable business agendas.
· Supply Chain Decarbonization: Develop a deep understanding of Scope 3 emissions, low-carbon logistics, and supplier decarbonization strategies, and drive meaningful conversations around net zero transition across value chains.
· Circular & Traceable Supply Chains: Design go-to-market and entry strategies for clients embedding circularity, traceability, and regulatory compliance (EUDR, CSDDD, DPP) into their supply chain and product strategies.

Our Reinvention Services span Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capability in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients in more than 120 countries, with offices and operations in 52 countries and more than 200 cities, and reported revenues of approximately US$70 billion in fiscal 2025. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
About the Role
Accenture Commodity Markets, part of Accenture CEO Advisory, helps organizations address complex strategy, trading and market transformation challenges through industry expertise, analytics, technology and AI.
Based in Singapore, the Strategy Consultant will support engagements across commodity markets and trading, including market strategy, commercial and portfolio optimization, trading and risk capabilities, operating models, and data and AI-enabled transformation.
Key Responsibilities
· Manage defined workstreams across strategy and transformation engagements.
· Conduct market, competitor, commercial, financial, and operational analysis and translate findings into practical recommendations.
· Support client interviews, workshops and presentations for senior stakeholders.
· Work on commodity market strategy, trading and risk management, portfolio optimisation, operating models and technology transformation.
· Develop business cases, market assessments, scenario analyses and commercial evaluations.
· Collaborate with multidisciplinary and international teams.
· Use digital, analytics and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support research and delivery.
· Contribute to proposals, market research, thought leadership and practice development.
What we need:
· Typically 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in strategy consulting, commodity markets, energy, trading, risk management or a related industry.
· Strong analytical, quantitative and structured problem-solving skills.
· Experience working with clients or senior stakeholders.
· Ability to interpret market, commercial and financial information and communicate clear recommendations.
· Strong presentation and communication skills, with written and verbal proficiency in English.
· Ability to work effectively across diverse and geographically distributed teams.
· Interest in commodity markets, trading, technology, data and AI.
Preferred Experience
· Exposure to energy, metals, mining, agriculture, chemicals, utilities, transportation or other commodity-related sectors.
· Knowledge of trading, hedging, risk management, market fundamentals, portfolio optimisation or commercial strategy.
· Experience with market modelling, financial analysis, data visualization or programming tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Python, R or SQL.
· Relevant finance, economics, engineering, business or quantitative qualifications are advantageous.
Location and Working Arrangements
· Based in Singapore.
· Travel may be required depending on business and client needs.
· Flexible working arrangements may apply, with client-site presence where required.
Why Join Us
Work on complex commodity market and trading challenges alongside experienced Accenture professionals while developing your skills through varied assignments, continuous learning and exposure to international teams.
Next Steps
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career interests, we encourage you to apply.

You Are
An experienced change leader who understands that work has fundamentally changed. Digital, data, and Generative AI are no longer emerging capabilities – they are part of the everyday fabric of how work gets done, decisions are made, and value is created. You have led complex transformations in environments where people work alongside advanced digital tools, and you know how this shifts roles, skills, ways of working, and expectations of leadership. You bring a clear point of view on how to design and lead change when speed, scale, and continuous adaptation are the norm, and where human judgment, accountability, and trust remain essential. You use data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to inform decisions and guide action, while applying experience and judgment to interpret what the data cannot. You are comfortable using Generative AI to accelerate analysis, design, and delivery, and you take responsibility for the quality, ethics, and impact of the outcomes. Clients and teammates look to you not just to “manage change,” but to help them operate and lead effectively in human + digital teams. You model how AI is used in the flow of work, coach others to build confidence and capability, and help teams deliver high-impact change in environments of continuous reinvention.
The Work
You will help clients reinvent how their organizations operate in an AI-enabled, data-informed world where work is digital by default, change is continuous, and people work alongside advanced tools to deliver outcomes at speed and scale.

· Help clients build lasting, scalable change capabilities so they can continuously adapt as technologies, business models and ways of working evolve.
· Contribute to Accenture business development through proposals, storytelling, and building trusted client relationships.
· Be willing to travel as needed to support clients.

· Supporting GenAI-enabled learning, reskilling, and knowledge sharing within organizations
· Enabling responsible GenAI adoption through clear change approaches, governance, and human accountability

Description
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm with more than 13,000 entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals across 90+ offices in over 50 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Corporate Finance Team
A&M's Corporate Finance practice sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. Our team advises corporate clients, founder and family-owned businesses, private equity sponsors, and financial institutions across the full deal lifecycle — from buy-side and sell-side M&A advisory to capital raises and strategic alternatives. We bring deep sector expertise , a hands-on advisory model, and a relentless focus on getting transactions across the finish line.
What You'll Do
Financial Modeling & Analytics
· Own all financial modeling and quantitative analysis on engagements — internal and external — with full accountability for accuracy, completeness, and presentation quality.
· Build and maintain complex financial models and valuation analyses, including LBO, DCF, comparable company and precedent transaction analyses; the team relies on your output without detailed review.
· Run structured data collection processes, control information flow across workstreams, and cross-check figures to ensure integrity end-to-end.
Transaction Execution
· Coordinate day-to-day execution across active mandates — managing timelines, workstreams, and deliverables to drive transactions forward with minimal senior oversight.
· Oversee the preparation and quality of origination and execution materials, including confidential information memoranda, management presentations, buyers lists , data room indices, and pitchbooks.
· Review and refine buyer lists and buyer universe analyses prepared by junior team members to support sell-side other engagements.
· Lead due diligence workstreams and support capital markets processes, anticipating needs and managing information requests between client teams and counterparties.
Leadership & Client Engagement
· Manage, train, and mentor Analysts across both origination and deal execution — setting a high bar for quality and fostering their development.
· Interact directly and credibly with clients and senior team members; take an active role in informal presentations and participate meaningfully in client meetings.
· Demonstrate strong initiative — understand the full context of each engagement, identify next steps proactively, and operate with the judgment and independence expected at the Associate level.
Business Development
· Build internal relationships across A&M's broader platform — including Transaction Advisory, Restructuring, and sector teams — to identify and pursue cross-practice collaboration opportunities.
· Actively seek external marketing exposure; begin developing the client relationships and market presence that will define your career trajectory at A&M.
Who You Are
· Bachelor's degree in Finance , Business or Accounting preferred; minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5
· FINRA securities licenses including the SIE , Series 79 and Series 63 are preferred. Successful candidates will be expected to obtain the required licenses as part of the onboarding process
· Minimum 3 years of investment banking experience at the Analyst level required ; experience at a bulge bracket, middle market, or boutique advisory firm preferred.
· Demonstrated expertise in M&A execution, including buy-side and sell-side processes, due diligence, and transaction documentation.
· Expert-level three-statement financial modeling — fast, accurate , and independent; output will be relied upon by senior deal team members without detailed review.
· Deep knowledge of valuation methodologies including comparable company analysis, precedent transactions, DCF, LBO, and sum-of-the-parts.
· Knowledge of capital markets and investment banking products across debt, equity, and M&A.
· Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Bloomberg.
· Highly developed written and oral communication skills; ability to present clearly and confidently in both internal and client-facing settings.
· Proven ability to manage and mentor junior team members while simultaneously driving execution across multiple workstreams.
· Strong work ethic, sharp attention to detail, and high level of integrity.
Education, Licensing & Registration Requirements
Successful employment with A&M Securities is subject to receipt by A&M Securities of information satisfactory to A&M Securities, in its sole discretion, in response to a pre-employment background investigation, including, but not limited to, verification of educational qualifications, employment history, valid and active licenses, certifications and other professional credentials necessary for the role. Specifically, A&M Securities must receive confirmation within six (6) months of the commencement date that the successful candidate has received passing scores on the Series 63, Series 79 and Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) examinations and holds a valid and active Investment Banking Representative registration.
Your Journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can  acquire  new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
Benefits & Compensation
Compensation
The salary is $150,000 annually (TBD), dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography.  In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on  a number of  factors, including individual and firm performance.   Please ask your recruiter for  details .
Benefits
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to  participate  in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a  401(k) retirement  savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their  401(k) retirement  savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for  part time  employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click  here  for more information  regarding  A&M’s benefits programs
Culture & Values
At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

Ideas | People | Trust
We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions entrepreneurial organisations need to navigate today’s changing world.
We work with the companies that are Britain’s economic engine – ambitious, entrepreneurially-spirited and high growth businesses that fuel the economy - and directly advise the owners and management teams that lead them.
We’ll broaden your horizons
Our Advisory team provide a wide variety of services that deliver value-led advice and outcomes. They have an in-depth knowledge of business, industry sectors and markets and understand the constantly changing risks and opportunities at the heart of our clients’ affairs. The team work across strategy, operations and improvement as well as at a transactional and defined project level. From technology to risk advisory, they’re experts in following through on top-level instructions and resolving the finer details – all in one straight-forward package. When you join them, you’ll work on some of the world's most exciting financial operations and business deals, building your experience and expertise alongside the brightest minds in the industry.
We’ll help you succeed
Leading organisations trust us because of the quality of our advice. That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with them and building long-lasting relationships.
You’ll be someone who is both comfortable working pro-actively and managing your own tasks, as well as confident collaborating with others and communicating regularly with senior managers, directors, and BDO’s partners to help businesses effectively. You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to organisations we work with. .
As a Senior Analyst or Analyst you'll join our Tech, Risk & Governance team (TRG) part of our Digital practice withing Consulting. This is a rapidly growing business area. You'll help clients understand and manage the risks arising from technology, transformation and digital change. The client base is diverse and you'll support technology risk assessments, IT internal audits, controls assurance and advisory engagements that strengthen governance, resilience and confidence in our clients most critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a high performing digital team and develop your career.
You'll be someone with:
· Experience in technology risk, IT internal audit, IT assurance, risk and controls, or a closely related discipline, gained in professional services, financial services or another regulated organisation.
· Experience in one or more relevant areas: IT general controls and SOX/ICFR; cloud risk; DevOps and SDLC controls; ERP risk and controls; operational resilience; third-party technology risk; data or AI governance; end-user computing; programme assurance
· Financial services experience is desirable such as banks. insurers, asset managers, payments or capital markets organisations and frameworks such as FCA and PRA requirements, operational resilience and outsourcing or third-party risk expectations.
· A practical understanding of technology risks and controls, with the ability to analyse evidence, identify control weaknesses and communicate their business impact clearly.
· Relevant qualifications or progress towards them, such as CISA, ACA, ACCA, CIA, CRISC, CISSP or cloud certifications, would be advantageous but are not essential.
You’ll also be able to be yourself; we’ll recognise and value you for who you are and celebrate and reward your contributions to the business. We’re committed to agile working, and we offer everyone the opportunity to work in ways that suit them, their teams, and the task in hand.
At BDO, we’ll help you achieve your personal goals and career ambitions, and we have programmes, resources, and frameworks that provide clarity and structure around career development.
We’re in it together
Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture. From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.
Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another. At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.
We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for the companies we work with and satisfying experiences for our colleagues, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices. BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences. With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.
We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy.
Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better.

SRC is a diverse team, with a global footprint and consists of actuaries, engineers, natural catastrophe modelers and enterprise risk management specialists. SRC helps companies identify, quantify, and prioritize their major risks, and connect risk management decisions to corporate financial performance.
We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Risk Consultant within our SRC practice. You will be at the forefront of innovation and technology and get involved in a wide range of fascinating projects.
You will lead the delivery of data-driven insightful analyses to some of the world’s largest and complex organizations. Your modelling skills will be used to help clients quantify their risk and develop risk transfer strategies that exploit arbitrage opportunities among mitigation, transfer, and retention levers and align risk decisions with financial strategy enhancing organizational resilience and maximizing performance.
If you enjoy being intellectually stimulated, working with people from different industries and backgrounds, and deploying state-of-the-art tools and technology, we want to meet with you.
The Role
· Oversee and perform modeling analysis for clients’ risks by applying standard actuarial techniques as well as WTW proprietary tools
· Ensure quality of work by participating in our peer reviewing process
· Maintain a comprehensive audit trail for all analytical work
· Present analytical results and recommendations to clients in a timely and professional manner
· Ability to direct work for more junior colleagues and provide feedback and coaching
· Develop a trusted advisor relationship with internal WTW client relationship managers through effective communication and quality execution of projects
· Support the development of new business opportunities and enhancing existing relationships
· Participate in Research & Development of new initiatives as required
The Requirements
· 5+ years of risk/insurance analytic experience, actuarial experience desirable

Job Description
We are looking for Senior Consultants to join the water team in our growing UK environmental policy team. The role will sit in ICF’s European Policy, Research, Evaluation and Strategy unit.
ICF provides independent policy research, evaluation and analytical support to the Defra group and other UK public sector clients. We provide robust evidence and strategic support to policy-makers and regulators, using the latest research and evaluation methodologies, advanced data science and behavioural insights. We work across the full spectrum of UK environmental and related policies, from nature restoration to food production, climate adaptation to resource management.
We have a growing portfolio of work focused on diverse aspects of water policy. We are working on evaluations of flood risk management programmes, studies on new governance models for water resource management, mechanisms for mobilisation of finance for nature recovery, and appraisal of water-focused innovation programmes.
This demand for ICF support creates exciting opportunities for experienced consultants that have expertise in the evaluation of programmes, development of governance models and appraisal of investments in the water and flood resilience sector to work on projects that contribute directly to the development and improvement of policies and programmes.
When you join ICF we will provide you with the opportunity to develop your knowledge and skills further through excellent training and development support, structured career guidance systems, our mentoring programme, communities of practice and line management arrangements.
Successful candidates will have the following skills and experience:
· Demonstrable interest and experience in environmental policy, especially in relation to water policy in the UK (e.g. water resources, floods, water quality)
· Strong qualitative, quantitative and analytical skills
· Skills in evaluation, economic analysis and appraisal, impact assessment, data science, and/or environmental economics
· Good understanding of UK policy-making process (experience of working on assignments for the UK Government would be an advantage)
· Degree, Master’s degree or PhD in relevant discipline
· Relevant professional experience of at least 5 years
· Experience managing projects, including budgets and research teams
· Business development experience, including contributing to proposals / grant applications
· Exceptional ability to write and communicate in English
· Strong organisational and collaborative working skills
· Highly-developed interpersonal skills and self-motivation
Prior experience in a consulting environment would be an advantage but we also welcome applicants with backgrounds in academia, government and non-governmental employment.

· Deseables conocimientos en finanzas sostenibles, inventarios de gases de efecto invernadero (GEI) y estándares internacionales de sostenibilidad.

· Habilidades de análisis, organización, comunicación efectiva y trabajo en equipo.
· Capacidad para gestionar múltiples actividades, adaptarse a entornos dinámicos y cumplir con los plazos establecidos.
Principales funciones
· Participar en la ejecución de proyectos de consultoría en cambio climático y sostenibilidad corporativa, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos, plazos y presupuestos establecidos.
· Recopilar, procesar y analizar información ambiental, social y climática para el desarrollo de estudios, diagnósticos y evaluaciones técnicas.
· Contribuir en la elaboración de estudios relacionados con riesgos climáticos, descarbonización, inventarios de emisiones de GEI y estrategias de sostenibilidad.
· Elaborar informes técnicos, presentaciones y otros entregables para clientes, asegurando la calidad, precisión y consistencia de la información.
· Desarrollar análisis cuantitativos y cualitativos, incluyendo la sistematización, procesamiento y visualización de datos mediante herramientas digitales.
· Investigar y analizar tendencias, normativas, metodologías y estándares nacionales e internacionales aplicables a proyectos de cambio climático y sostenibilidad.
· Realizar seguimiento a las actividades y entregables asignados, identificando posibles desviaciones y proponiendo acciones de mejora.
· Participar en reuniones de coordinación con equipos internos y clientes, brindando soporte técnico y contribuyendo al seguimiento de los compromisos establecidos.
· Identificar oportunidades de mejora y eficiencias en la ejecución de los proyectos, promoviendo la optimización de procesos y metodologías de trabajo.
· Colaborar en la identificación de oportunidades de negocio y servicios transversales relacionados con cambio climático y sostenibilidad.
· Participar en visitas técnicas y actividades de campo, según las necesidades de los proyectos.
· Contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos de facturación y utilización establecidos para su nivel, mediante la ejecución eficiente de las actividades asignadas.
· Cumplir y promover los lineamientos de calidad, salud y seguridad de ERM, así como los requisitos establecidos por los clientes y proyectos.
Antecedentes:
Desde que establecimos nos establecimos en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) en la década de 1990, ERM ha crecido de manera constante, empleando ahora a más de 800 profesionales en sus oficinas de Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Guyana, México y Perú. Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido equipos de consultoría de clase mundial, especializados en medio ambiente, sostenibilidad y consultoría social, con una sólida base de clientes en múltiples sectores económicos como petróleo y gas, manufactura y productos químicos, entre otros. A lo largo de tiempos desafiantes, ERM ha permanecido comprometida en apoyar a estos sectores, ya que nuestros clientes continúan invirtiendo en el mercado local.
Como parte de nuestra expansión regional, ERM busca mantener el liderazgo en la industria asociándose con importantes clientes que comparten nuestro compromiso con la sostenibilidad. Con una base sólida en industrias clave, somos pioneros en el avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe. Nuestro trabajo incluye contribuir a iniciativas de financiamiento sostenible, desarrollar estudios temáticos y apoyar la implementación de estándares internacionales para las partes interesadas.
Quiénes Somos:
Como la mayor consultora global dedicada exclusivamente a la sostenibilidad, nos asociamos con las principales organizaciones del mundo, creando soluciones innovadoras a los desafíos de sostenibilidad y desbloqueando oportunidades comerciales que satisfacen las necesidades del presente, mientras preservamos oportunidades para las futuras generaciones.
También consideramos nuestra diversidad como una fortaleza que nos ayuda a crear mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo diverso de expertos de clase mundial apoya a los clientes en todos los niveles de sus organizaciones para operacionalizar la sostenibilidad, respaldado por nuestra profunda experiencia técnica en la resolución de temas ambientales, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y asuntos sociales. Llamamos a esta capacidad nuestro enfoque de "boots to boardroom" un modelo de servicio integral que permite a ERM desarrollar soluciones estratégicas y técnicas que impulsan objetivos tanto en el campo como a nivel ejecutivo.
Si deseas leer más sobre Diversidad, Equidad, Igualdad e Inclusión (DEIB) en ERM, puedes visitar nuestro sitio web o conocer nuestros avances en el Informe de Sostenibilidad 2026 .

At ERM , as an Senior Consultant, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Generalist, based in Overland Park, Kansas , you’ll be part of a global sustainability consulting firm that helps organizations solve some of their most pressing environmental and operational challenges. This is more than a technical role—it’s an opportunity to work alongside experienced Project Managers and Partners, contributing to projects that shape how businesses operate responsibly across industries. From compliance and sustainability to site investigation and remediation, your work will directly support safer, more sustainable outcomes for clients and communities.
Why This Role Matters?
This role sits at the intersection of environmental science, regulatory compliance, and business strategy. You’ll help organizations navigate complex EHS requirements while advancing sustainable practices. Your contributions will influence project outcomes, support regulatory compliance, and drive environmental stewardship across diverse client portfolios.
At ERM, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build expertise, collaborate with industry leaders, and develop a career path tailored to your strengths and interests.

· Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and access a network of national EHS experts for ongoing learning and development

· Detail-oriented with excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting/problem-solving skills
· Effective written and verbal communication, organizational, and analytical skills

jd_text:
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. We combine unmatched experience and specialized capabilities across more than 40 industries – powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. With 738,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings continuous innovation to help clients improve their performance and create lasting value across their enterprises. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
Through deep industry expertise , analytics and insights, Accenture Strategy empower s clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now and the unknown. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously identifying and investing in the new. Accenture Strategy consulting enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.
The Accenture Commodity Markets, part of Accenture Strategy, is a global practice operating across multiple industries. It is one of the few global strategy practices which provides a very steep cross-industry learning curve and a truly global professional experience, working with organizations focused on commodity production, trading, logistics and marketing.
We combine our unique industry knowledge in the energy, chemicals, soft commodities, agriculture, metals, mining, utilities, transportation and consumer goods amongst others with analytics-powered core strategy consulting skills, digital and applied intelligence to create unsurpassed value for our clients across the world.
We are known within Accenture for the variety and complexity of business issues we solve for our clients, our close-knit global team, empowerment of resources to hold responsibility early on, potential for rapid career progression and international exposure, having delivered projects in over 25 countries. Further, our group creates a diverse, multi- cultural and multi-functional environment for you to learn, develop and succeed.
Our four core capability areas are:
1) Trading and Risk Management: working with commodity-centric organizations to set-up and expand their commodity trading and risk management activities, partnering with them to optimize product margin, enhance supply certainty, and reduce price/volumetric volatility through state-of-the-art analytics, AI, and risk management techniques.
2) Investment Valuation & Financial Structuring: We work collaboratively with clients to shape investment / divestment transactions, devise investment strategies, support corporate restructuring, capital planning, balance-sheet optimization and other core strategic priorities around their asset portfolio.
3) Optimization: Also , we help clients create value by optimizing their value chain, be it through developing a new strategic direction because of digital disruption or market uncertainty, helping them grow and enter new markets, or even devising new, innovative and agile business models to help them pivot to the New. Underpinning this work, we also regularly partner with our clients to enhance their corporate functions' strategies and agility in support of the wider business model and strategic plan.
4 ) Energy Transition: Finally, we work with clients to shape their strategies to develop new businesses on the energy transition and shape their overall go to market approach, operating model and implementation for these new business models such as electricity, hydrogen, carbon markets, etc.
Key responsibilities:
Client Delivery and Development
· Global project experience both in Thailand but also in Southeast Asia and globally as part of the Accenture Commodity Markets Global Strategy project staffing pool
· Work within cross-office project and client teams including both Thailand and global Accenture Commodity Markets to solve complex business issues in one of our three core capability areas, bringing structure and rigorous quantitative and qualitative skills to deliver actionable recommendations, insights and results
· Work within project workstreams with supervision to identify value creation opportunities for our clients
· Work on and develop elements of analysis required to support project delivery
· Support client interviews and workshops, develop presentation materials and recommendations
· Work on topics including corporate strategy development, trading and risk management capability set-up, operating model design, commercial optimization, investment valuation and financial structuring, balance sheet analysis , energy market liberalization, energy transition and advanced numerical modelling of energy and commodity markets
Practice Building
· Contribute to developing Thailand & Global Accenture Commodity Markets and wider Accenture Strategy practice and community, and building Accenture Commodity Markets offerings, assets and thought leadership
· Support internal Business Development activities by conducting and managing industry and company-specific research (competitors, market scanning and market fundamentals, financials, customers, etc.), as well as the development of client proposal presentations
Required Qualifications
· A n undergraduate degree or master’s degree from a leading academic institution
· Y ou’ll need to be a critical, creative and deep strategic thinker and able to break down and solve problems structurally and be able to demonstrate project evidence of this on your CV
· It’s also important that you are a natural leader, effective relationship builder and collaborative teammate who’s digitally savvy and up for a challenge
· With strong communication skills, you should feel comfortable leading workshops and have good presentation skills
· You will also need to be intellectually curious, eager to learn and have a desire to help companies turn disruption into opportunity through strategies that enable them to successfully execute with equal strength across growth, profitability sustainability and trust
· You should have the ability to work effectively in ambiguous and ever-changing environments
· Quantitative and analytical skills and a real passion for business and technology are key . Ideally, you will have taken classes in statistics or data analytics and will know how to work data visualisation tools ( PowerBI , Tableau, Alteryx) or programming languages (R, Python, Julia, SQL)
· Experience in international or multicultural work and education would be preferable
· An interest in commodities markets, the energy sector and the energy transition are highly desirable
· Proficiency to communicate verbally and in writing in English and Thai
Why join us?
· We offer a differentiated , fast paced approach career progression and employee offering which is unique to Strategy , with a focus on your strengths and continuous coaching from senior colleagues  in Thailand and Global Accenture Commodity Markets
· You will have the chance to work with leading business executives in Thailand and globally to drive the most pressing business issues of our time and solve top-agenda topics with our clients
· You will have the opportunity to work within Thailand as well as travel in Southeast Asia and globally for strategy projects , providing professional development opportunities around the world throughout Global Accenture Commodity Markets network
· You will  benefit from working alongside Accenture experts who are solving some of the biggest industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools
· Flexible work arrangements and a range of benefits including competitive rewards
· You will have access to state-of-the-art technology that will give you the opportunity to deepen your existing skills even as you help create the latest business trends

jd_text:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?​
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
WSP is one of the world's leading engineering and environmental professional services firms providing technical consultancy to the built and natural environment. We believe that for societies to thrive, we must all hold ourselves accountable for tomorrow. For us, that means creating innovative solutions to the challenges the future will bring to the communities and environments where we live and work across the UK.
We are locally dedicated and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors, including engineers, technicians, scientists, planners, surveyors, geo-science and environmental specialists, as well as other design, programme and construction management professionals. Our experts influence and design sustainable lasting solutions in the property & buildings, transportation & infrastructure, earth & environment, industry and power & energy sectors as well as project delivery and strategic consulting services.
ROLE
As Senior Consultant - Future Energy Networks , you will deliver and increasingly lead high-quality consulting projects and workstreams that help network operators, utilities and other energy-sector clients plan, transform and future-proof energy systems. Future Energy Networks is part of WSP's wider integrated Energy Advisory business, which brings together four core capabilities:
· Markets Advisory – helping clients understand how energy markets operate, how market arrangements evolve, and how commercial value is created.
· Policy & Regulation – supporting governments, regulators, system operators and utilities with policy development, economic regulation and regulatory reform.
· Energy Decarbonisation – helping organisations, cities, utilities and governments secure, plan and optimise energy in an increasingly electrified economy.
· Future Energy Networks – supporting network operators and utilities to plan, transform, deliver and future-proof the energy systems of the future.
Energy Advisory operates as a single integrated business, and all consultants are encouraged to contribute across multiple capabilities. This provides opportunities to broaden technical and consulting skills, work on multidisciplinary projects and develop a deeper understanding of the energy transition.
Working alongside engineers, economists, policy specialists, strategists and commercial advisors, you will deliver projects and increasingly lead defined workstreams across areas such as network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation and innovation. You will engage directly with clients, apply sound analysis and judgement, and take ownership of clear, practical and high-quality outputs.
You will contribute to the development of Future Energy Networks and the wider Energy Advisory business through knowledge sharing, business development and the improvement of our services and ways of working. We are looking for relevant experience in one or more areas, strong consulting or delivery skills, and the curiosity and potential to develop across the wider Future Energy Networks agenda.
RESPONSIBILITIES
· Delivering consulting projects and defined workstreams, with increasing responsibility for planning, coordination and successful outcomes.
· Taking ownership of high-quality project outputs, including technical accuracy, clear communication, timely delivery and effective use of project resources.
· Applying relevant experience to challenges in network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation, innovation and related areas of the energy transition.
· Developing proportionate analytical approaches, work plans and recommendations in response to client requirements.
· Engaging directly with client stakeholders, presenting findings clearly and building trusted working relationships.
· Working effectively in multidisciplinary teams and, where appropriate, coordinating colleagues and supporting their development.
· Delivering technical, commercial, economic, policy and strategic analysis to support client decision-making.
· Contributing to business cases, regulatory submissions, market assessments, network or energy strategies and implementation plans.
· Identifying practical improvements to tools, methods and approaches that strengthen project delivery and WSP's advisory capability.
· Contributing to proposals, bids, client development and other business development activities.
· Supporting the development of Future Energy Networks services, market offerings and team capability.
· Sharing knowledge and, where relevant, contributing to publications, events and wider industry engagement.
KEY COMPETENCIES AND EXPERIENCE
· Relevant experience gained in consulting, electricity networks, utilities or the wider energy sector.
· Experience contributing to the delivery of consulting, advisory, technical or strategic projects, with evidence of increasing responsibility for projects or workstreams.
· Knowledge or experience in one or more areas such as network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation, innovation, resilience or energy-system planning.
· Ability to work effectively in complex or evolving environments, using sound judgement and seeking support where appropriate.
· Experience engaging directly with clients or other stakeholders and translating their needs into clear, practical outputs.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
· Ability to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, both in writing and verbally.
· Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
· Good commercial awareness, including an understanding of project delivery, client value and the role of business development.
· Experience supporting, mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or a willingness to develop these skills.
· Ability to collaborate across disciplines and contribute constructively to team and capability development.
· A willingness and ability to contribute across the wider Energy Advisory business beyond your primary area of experience.
QUALIFICATIONS
· A degree or equivalent relevant experience in an engineering, scientific, technical, economic, policy or related discipline.
· Chartered status, or progress towards professional accreditation with a relevant body, is desirable but not essential.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
With us, you can.

jd_text:
Consultant / Senior Consultant – Strategy & Economics
UK, with flexibility on office location across London, Manchester, Edinburgh
Do you enjoy tackling complex strategic, policy, economic and commercial questions for public and private-sector clients? Are you experienced in shaping strategies and policies, appraising options, assessing economic impacts or building robust business and investment cases? Would you like to turn evidence into clear recommendations that inform and support strategic decisions across major infrastructure, sustainability and transition challenges?
If this sounds like you, join Ramboll Management Consulting UK and help our clients understand opportunities, make investment decisions and translate strategy into action.
Your new role
Help clients make better strategic, policy and investment decisions.
We are looking for a Consultant or Senior Consultant with a background in management consulting, economics or a related advisory discipline. You will combine structured problem-solving, rigorous analysis and clear communication to help public- and private-sector clients assess opportunities, appraise options and develop strategies and business cases.
Working across energy, infrastructure, transport and sustainability, you will collaborate with Ramboll’s technical specialists to turn evidence into practical recommendations. You will bring a particular strength in strategy and commercial advisory, economic appraisal or policy analysis, with opportunities to develop across complementary areas.
Our work spans three complementary areas:
· Strategy and commercial advisory: market assessment, commercial analysis, growth strategy, investment appraisal and strategic options.
· Economics and public policy: economic appraisal, cost-benefit analysis, economic impact assessment, policy analysis and evaluation.
· Consulting delivery: structured problem-solving, analytical workstream leadership, project management, client relationships and evidence-based recommendations. A particular strength of Ramboll's management consulting offer is the ability to combine management consulting with wider technical and subject-matter expertise. Work alongside economists, strategy consultants, engineers and sustainability specialists, combining rigorous analysis with technical insight to develop recommendations grounded in how infrastructure, markets and investment decisions work in practice.
At Consultant level, you will take ownership of analytical workstreams and contribute directly to client advice. At Senior Consultant level, you will lead projects, manage client relationships, guide colleagues and contribute to winning new work.
Your key responsibilities will be:
· Undertaking market, commercial and strategic assessments , including market studies, feasibility studies and analysis of investment and growth opportunities.
· Undertake economic appraisal and develop business and investment cases , applying quantitative and qualitative evidence and drawing on economic, commercial, financial and sustainability analysis to assess impacts, appraise strategic options and support robust policy and investment decisions.
· Leading projects and workstreams from problem definition through to recommendation, structuring analysis, coordinating colleagues and ensuring high-quality outputs.
· Engaging directly with clients and senior stakeholders , communicating insights through clear presentations, reports and compelling recommendations.
· Supporting the growth of our strategy, economics and advisory work , including contributing to proposals, developing client relationships, developing new services and identifying opportunities across our priority markets. About you
You will bring depth in one or more of strategy and commercial advisory, economic appraisal, or policy analysis and evaluation. We do not expect expertise across every service area; we value strong analytical judgement and the ability to work with colleagues who bring complementary skills.
We believe the following experience and capabilities will set you up for success:
· Relevant experience in management consulting, economic consulting, public policy or a comparable analytical advisory role in the UK or Ireland, with evidence of translating complex analysis into practical recommendations for decision-makers.
· Strong experience in business case development, market assessment, feasibility studies and/or strategy development, with the ability to undertake research and turn evidence and analysis into practical client recommendations. Experience in the application of HM Treasury Green Book appraisal and the Five Case Model would be beneficial.
· Excellent communication skills , including client engagement, presentations, report writing and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to senior audiences.
· Experience of managing consulting projects or significant workstreams , including coordinating and supporting other team members.
· Knowledge of at least one of our priority sectors: energy; finance; or transport, infrastructure and mobility , combined with curiosity and a desire to develop expertise across new topics and sectors. What we can offer you
· Investment in your development
· Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
· Be valued for the unique person you are
· Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
· The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
· Flexible work environment
· Hybrid working
· 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
· Matched pension contributions
· Private medical cover and life assurance Work at the heart of sustainable change
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.
Ready to join us?
Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.
Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Role: Strategy Consultant, Commodity Markets
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangkok, Thailand
Practice: Accenture Commodity Markets, CEO Advisory
About Accenture
Accenture helps the world's leading organisations reinvent themselves, building their digital core and putting AI to work to create value at speed. We bring together approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep industry and process expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships. Our Reinvention Services span Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capability in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients in more than 120 countries, with offices and operations in 52 countries and more than 200 cities, and reported revenues of approximately US$70 billion in fiscal 2025. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
About Accenture CEO Advisory
Accenture CEO Advisory works with chief executives, boards and their leadership teams on the decisions that set enterprise direction: where to compete, what to own, how to fund a shift in the portfolio, and what the operating model has to become to support it. The work sits upstream of execution but is judged on whether it survives contact with it, so we pair industry depth with the quantitative, technology and delivery capability to pressure-test an answer before a client commits capital behind it.
About Accenture Commodity Markets
Accenture Commodity Markets (ACM), part of Accenture CEO Advisory, is a global practice operating across multiple industries. It is one of the few global strategy practices offering a steep cross-industry learning curve alongside genuinely global project experience, working with organisations focused on commodity production, trading, logistics and marketing.
We combine industry knowledge across energy, chemicals, soft commodities, agriculture, metals, mining, utilities, transportation and consumer goods with analytics-led core strategy consulting, digital and AI capability.
Within Accenture we are known for the variety and complexity of the problems we take on, a close-knit global team, early responsibility for our people, rapid career progression and international exposure, having delivered projects in over 25 countries.
Our solution areas are:
Investment and Asset Portfolio Optimisation: portfolio strategy, capital allocation, long-term market modelling, M&A support, and integrated optimisation across physical and financial positions. Trading and Market Optimisation: trading strategy, positioning and risk management through advanced analytics, real-time insight, hedging, algorithmic trading and P&L attribution. Commodity Markets Decision Platforms, Ecosystem and Execution: AI-enabled decision platforms, CTRM and ETRM selection, ecosystem partners (Salesforce, Palantir and others), data architecture, AI model development and automation. Enterprise Activation and Operational Readiness: making sure organisations are ready to operate, trade and optimise from day one, covering operating model design, go-live strategy and capability build-out. Commodity Sourcing and Exposure Management: sourcing, hedging and supplier strategy for commodity-exposed industries, optimising cost, risk and resilience under market volatility.
About the Role in Thailand
ACM in Thailand advises state enterprises, listed energy groups and large industrial corporates on decisions that set their direction for the next decade: how to position a portfolio through the energy transition, what gas and power market liberalisation does to a commercial model, whether an asset or an acquisition earns its cost of capital, and how to stand up the trading and commercial capability a deregulated market demands.
Regulatory and transition depth in the Thai and wider ASEAN energy system runs through most of that work. Third-party access regimes, tariff structures, PPA economics and market design are commercial questions for our clients, and we are expected to hold a defensible view on them.
We also build with AI as a matter of course. Market and competitor scans, document-heavy regulatory review and first-cut modelling run with GenAI in the workflow. That changes how much ground a small team can cover, and it raises the bar on what counts as analysis rather than description.
The Thailand team is small and growing. You will own a workstream and its client relationships early, and you will present your own work to client leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery and Development
· Lead project workstreams to closure with limited supervision, from framing the question through to the recommendation you defend in front of the client.
· Work on engagements in Thailand and across Southeast Asia, with access to the ACM global staffing pool for projects further afield.
· Work in cross-office teams spanning ACM Thailand and global ACM, bringing structure and quantitative and qualitative rigour to problems across our solution areas.
· Build and own the analysis behind the answer: financial and operational models, market and asset economics, and the numerical modelling of energy and commodity markets.
· Run client interviews and workshops, build the materials, and hold your own in the conversation about approach and recommendation.
· Work across corporate and portfolio strategy, energy transition positioning, market liberalisation and regulatory response, trading and risk capability set-up, operating model design, commercial optimisation, investment valuation and financial structuring, and balance sheet analysis.
· Use GenAI tooling as a default part of how you work, and take responsibility for the quality of what comes out of it.
· Develop client relationships by staying close to how each client actually decides, and stay market relevant through thought leadership and taking fresh ideas to them unprompted. Practice Building
· Contribute to ACM Thailand, global ACM and the wider Accenture CEO Advisory community, and to building ACM offerings, assets and thought leadership.
· Support business development by running industry and company research (competitor and market scanning, market fundamentals, financials, customers) and by building proposal materials.
· Coach analysts on your workstream, on both the analysis and how it is communicated.
Required Experience
· An undergraduate and master's degree from a leading academic institution.
· 3-6 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, or in a relevant commercial, strategy or corporate development role in industry.
· Strong quantitative skills and comfort owning a financial or operational model end to end, including the assumptions and their defensibility.
· Business case development and financial analysis, with fluency reading and interrogating financial statements.
· Structured, hypothesis-led problem solving, and the ability to take a position where the evidence is incomplete and say what would change it.
· Working proficiency with GenAI tools in analytical work, and the judgement to know where their output cannot be trusted.
· Professional fluency in Thai and English, written and spoken.
· Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality output with multicultural teams under short timeframes. Desirable
· AI capability that goes beyond tool use, combined with quantitative modelling and commodity market knowledge.
· Sector exposure in energy, utilities, chemicals, agriculture, or metals and mining.
· Understanding of the Thai and ASEAN energy sector and its regulatory institutions.
· Exposure to commodity trading, risk management, or investment and asset valuation.
· International study or work experience. Location and Working Arrangements
· Based in Bangkok, Thailand.
· Travel across Southeast Asia and, for global staffing, further afield.
· Flexible working arrangements, with the expectation of client site presence where the engagement requires it. Why Join Us
· The Thailand practice is small and in build phase, so you carry real scope from the first engagement and you are visible to practice leadership from the start.
· Direct exposure to C-suite and board-level decisions at some of Thailand's largest energy and industrial groups, on questions where the answer is genuinely open.
· Access to the ACM global staffing pool, so cross-border and cross-industry project experience does not require leaving the practice.
· Continuous coaching from senior colleagues in ACM Thailand and global ACM, with a specialisation path set out deliberately rather than left to whatever staffing throws up.
· Flexible work arrangements and a competitive rewards package. Next Steps
If this sounds like the right role, career and company for you, click below to apply.
