Description
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
Alvarez & Marsal is actively building a market-leading global team within Disputes and Investigations, focused on anti-financial crime and fraud. We are looking for talented professionals eager to grow with the firm, contribute to engagement delivery, and help elevate A&M’s presence in the disputes, anti-financial crime and fraud ecosystem.
The environment is intentionally dynamic. New team members have the opportunity to contribute to the global build-out, help shape the next generation of anti-financial crime services at A&M, and work alongside other practices across our global network.
How you will contribute
We are seeking a motivated Associate to support our engagements across AML-CFT, sanctions/PEP screening, fraud, KYC, market abuse and transaction monitoring. This role is designed for a professional with up to seven years of experience who combines solid anti-financial crime and fraud knowledge with an interest in technology and the drive to grow within a fast-moving advisory environment.
In this role, you will:
· Support the delivery of anti-financial crime engagements and transformation programmes across AML-CFT, sanctions, fraud, KYC, market abuse and transaction monitoring.
· Research and analyse emerging risks, regulatory trends, and technology innovation, and summarise key insights for senior team members and clients.
· Contribute to the selection, implementation, and optimisation of anti-financial crime and fraud platforms (e.g., transaction monitoring, screening, case management, trade surveillance).
· Support the application of AI/ML models, advanced analytics, and automation to enhance detection effectiveness and operational efficiency.
· Assess systems and processes against regulatory expectations (e.g., AMLA / AMLR) and industry best practices.
· Support risk assessments, model performance reviews, and scenario optimisation exercises.
· Participate in discussions with clients, regulators, and auditors alongside senior team members.
· Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget and contribute to project planning and tracking.
· Collaborate with colleagues and support junior team members, sharing knowledge and contributing to a positive team environment.
· Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Qualifications
· 4–7 years of experience in anti-financial crime, fraud and compliance domains, ideally in consulting, banking, fintech, or financial services.
· Exposure to transformation, remediation, or advisory programmes in financial services.
· Solid understanding of AML-CFT, sanctions, fraud, KYC, market abuse and regulatory expectations.
· Working knowledge of anti-financial crime systems.
· Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to stakeholders.
· Ability to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams and manage own workstreams with guidance.
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

Launch Your Career in Environmental Consulting and Help Shape Sustainable Development Across Canada
At ERM , your work will help guide some of Canada's most significant infrastructure, renewable energy, mining, transportation, and resource development projects. As a Consulting Senior Associate, Environmental Assessment and Permitting based in Vancouver, BC, Calgary, AB, or Toronto, ON , you will play a meaningful role in helping clients navigate complex regulatory processes while supporting environmentally and socially responsible project outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career professional to collaborate with industry-leading experts, strengthen consulting and project management skills, and contribute to projects that create lasting value for communities, businesses, and the environment.
Why This Role Matters
Environmental approvals and permitting play a critical role in advancing projects that support communities, economic development, and the transition to a more sustainable future. In this role, you will help clients navigate regulatory requirements, support environmental assessment processes, and contribute to strategic solutions for complex environmental challenges.
As part of ERM's multidisciplinary team, you will gain exposure to projects across Canada, work alongside recognized technical specialists, and build expertise within one of the world's leading sustainability consulting organizations. Your work will directly influence responsible project development while helping clients balance environmental, social, and business objectives.
What Your Impact Is
As a Consulting Senior Associate, Environmental Assessment and Permitting, you will support the planning, permitting, and environmental assessment of projects across sectors such as renewable energy, mining, transportation, and oil and gas. Your contributions will help clients make informed decisions, meet regulatory requirements, engage stakeholders effectively, and advance projects responsibly.
You will:
· Support regulatory, permitting, and environmental impact assessment activities for a variety of client projects.
· Collaborate with project managers and technical specialists to deliver high-quality project outcomes that meet client expectations.
· Support community and stakeholder engagement activities throughout project planning and permitting processes.
· Assist with permit application scoping, regulatory research, technical writing, permitting documentation, environmental management plans, and development of client recommendations.
· Coordinate and integrate technical input from ERM subject matter experts.
· Support project delivery by helping manage data collection, information review, GIS coordination, desktop publishing assignments, and regulatory documentation.
· Build collaborative relationships with ERM professionals across Canada and around the world.
· Contribute to business development initiatives through client research, proposal preparation, and marketing support activities.
· Apply critical thinking and strategic problem-solving to help deliver meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.
What You'll Bring
Required
· Bachelor's degree in Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
· 1+ years of experience in the environmental or sustainability field.
· Understanding of environmental and social effects related to mining, oil and gas, renewable energy, transportation, and/or related developments.
· Interest in project management, including deliverable tracking, budget tracking, and client communications.
· Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
· Excellent writing, communication, organization, attention to detail, and time management skills. Please demonstrate within application, resume, and cover letter.

· Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
· Strong commitment to safety and adherence to established health and safety protocols.
· Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
· Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to collect, synthesize, and evaluate large amounts of information.
· Demonstrated growth mindset with the ability and desire to continuously learn and apply new knowledge and skills.
· Collaborative, dependable, adaptable, and flexible working style.
· Positive and confident approach when working with colleagues, clients, stakeholders, and project teams.
· Driver's License Required: This position requires a valid driver's license and/or the ability to operate a company vehicle due to the nature of job duties, which include frequent travel to various client locations across a large geographical area.
· This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
Preferred
· Experience in environmental consulting, industry, or government.
· Awareness of Canadian federal, provincial, and territorial regulations and guidelines, particularly environmental assessment and permitting processes in British Columbia, Alberta, Ontario, Yukon, Northwest Territories, and/or Nunavut, or familiarity with similar legislation in other jurisdictions.
· Fluency in additional languages, including Indigenous languages and/or French.

· Provide input on regulatory, permitting, and environmental impact assessment tasks in support of client projects.
· Support multiple projects simultaneously alongside project managers to ensure successful project delivery and quality outcomes.
· Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities.
· Prepare and review technical documentation, permit applications, environmental management plans, and supporting regulatory materials.
· Conduct data gathering, regulatory research, permitting reviews, and technical analyses.
· Coordinate project-related workstreams and collaborate with GIS, desktop publishing, and technical specialist teams.
· Support proposal preparation, market research, and business development activities.
· Develop practical recommendations and solutions that help clients achieve project objectives while meeting regulatory requirements.
· Foster strong working relationships with colleagues across ERM's global network.
· Contribute to a culture of safety, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
For the Consulting Senior Associate, Environmental Assessment and Permitting position, the anticipated annual base pay is $68,700–$85,900 (CAD) . jd_text:
Job Family :
Management Consulting
Travel Required :
Up to 10%
Clearance Required :
Ability to Obtain Public Trust
What You Will Do:
· Conduct organizational assessments of HQ functions, missions, staffing structures, and operating models to identify opportunities for organizational optimization and workforce realignment.
· Develop future-state organizational structures, functional alignments, organizational charts, and position frameworks to support agency transformation initiatives.
· Facilitate executive interviews, workshops, and stakeholder working sessions to capture leadership priorities, validate findings, and build consensus around transformation recommendations.
· Develop business cases, implementation roadmaps, and workforce transition strategies that support senior leadership decision-making and organizational change execution.
· Design governance models, decision-right frameworks, and roles and responsibilities matrices to support future-state operating environments.
· Assess organizational change impacts and develop change management, communication, and stakeholder engagement plans to drive adoption of new organizational structures.
· Analyze workforce, workload, and operational data to support staffing baseline development, resource planning, and organizational design recommendations.
· Prepare executive-level briefings, presentations, reports, and client deliverables for senior federal government stakeholders.
· Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
What You Will Need:
· Three (3) to Five (5) years of experience supporting organizational transformation, organizational design, workforce planning, or management consulting engagements.
· Bachelor's Degree or Seven (7) years of experience in lieu of degree.
· Experience conducting organization-wide assessments, current-state/future-state analyses, and operating model evaluations.
· Demonstrated experience developing organizational structures, governance frameworks, and workforce alignment recommendations.
· Experience supporting large-scale change management and organizational transformation efforts using structured methodologies and stakeholder engagement approaches.
· Strong facilitation skills with experience leading executive interviews, workshops, focus groups, and leadership meetings.
· Ability to develop data-driven business cases, implementation plans, and strategic recommendations for senior executives.
· Exceptional technical writing and presentation skills, including development of executive briefings, governance documentation, and decision support materials.
What Would Be Nice To Have:
· Experience supporting the Department of Transportation or other federal civilian agencies.
· Knowledge of federal human capital frameworks, workforce optimization methodologies, and organizational governance models.
· Experience supporting headquarters reorganizations, shared services transitions, or enterprise operating model redesigns.
· Prosci, CCMP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, SHRM, or related professional certification.
· Experience conducting workload analyses, staffing model development, or workforce planning assessments.
· Experience drafting or revising organizational manuals, governance documents, policies, directives, or functional statements.
· Familiarity with workforce analytics, organizational data visualization, or workforce modeling tools used to support strategic decision-making.
The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

· Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance

Location: Dublin

About TS&T Ireland
Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS&T) a key part of our growing Digital Core service. Here, we develop company-wide IT and digitalisation strategies that exploit ground-breaking technologies and strategically advise our Fortune 500 CIO clients on how to reinvent their IT operating models, enterprise and data architectures, take advantage of cloud, and improve the value they are getting from their IT investments. Our practice has been consistently rated as the best team in the industry by the Financial Times based on client ratings and was key for Accenture to be named a leader by Forrester .
The Opportunity for You
We are looking for a motivated technology and business consulting professional to join our growing Technology Strategy and Transformation practice. This role is suited to candidates who want to build their experience helping clients shape and deliver technology-led reinvention across the Digital Core. You will work alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists while developing your own expertise across technology strategy, AI enablement, architecture, digital foundations and transformation delivery.
This role is suited to candidates who bring a strong consulting foundation and experience across several areas of technology strategy, architecture, AI enablement, digital foundations, technology effectiveness, and transformation delivery.
We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every area; we value thoughtful generalists who can connect business priorities, technology choices, delivery realities, and measurable value outcomes while continuing to be curious about learning.
In this role, you will help clients define, shape and deliver technology products, platforms, operating models and transformation programmes that unlock business value, improve agility and accelerate outcomes. You will work closely with client stakeholders, business and industry specialists, engineering teams, architects, designers, analysts, partner vendors and delivery teams to create practical, high-quality outcomes.
What you will help clients do:
· Support and drive strategic advisory projects, programmes and workstreams from shaping through to delivery, keeping stakeholders aligned, informed and focused on outcomes.
· Help clients define how technology functions can create business value through effective operating models, product and platform structures, governance, organisation design and ways of working.
· Contribute to developing transformation strategies, business cases and roadmaps that are pragmatic, actionable and linked to measurable value
· Assess current-state maturity across areas such as architecture, agile delivery, modern engineering, operating models, governance, AI readiness and technology ways of working.
· Support the assessment of AI and emerging technology opportunities on how these will impact IT operation modes, architectures and transformation deliveries
· Guide practical adoption of AI in the software development lifecycle, helping teams reduce delivery cost, improve engineering effectiveness and accelerate time to value.
· Provide clear updates on progress, risks, issues, actions and dependencies to support effective decision-making.
What you will do:
· Work with business and technology leaders to define technology strategies, future-state roadmaps, and practical transformation plans.
· Help clients build AI-ready digital foundations across data, cloud, infrastructure, platforms, enterprise architecture, and modern delivery practices.
· Assess technology estates, operating models, delivery capabilities, resilience, cost, and value to identify opportunities for improvement.
· Support complex transformation programmes by helping teams establish governance, manage risk, track value, and maintain delivery momentum.
· Collaborate across business, technology, data, engineering, infrastructure, managed services, and ecosystem partners to create joined-up solutions.
· Conduct research, analysis and assessments to support technology strategy and transformation engagements.
· Develop presentations, reports, business cases and recommendations for client stakeholders.
· Support workshops, stakeholder interviews and working sessions.
· Gather and analyse information to identify opportunities, risks and improvement actions.
· Work with multidisciplinary teams to translate strategy into actionable outcomes.
Experience Requirements:
· Solid experience in consulting, technology strategy or technology transformation teams ( typically 3+ years ).
· Proven track record supporting technology programmes.
· Experience managing client relationships and stakeholders.
Core skills we expect everyone to bring:
· AI awareness and curiosity: a practical understanding of how AI, data, and automation are changing businesses, technology functions, and delivery methods.
· Strong communication and storytelling: the ability to explain complex ideas clearly, tailor messages for different audiences, and build confidence with stakeholders.
· Project and change skills: experience helping teams plan, organise, govern, and deliver change in complex environments.
· Business and technology judgement: the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, value, risk, cost, and feasibility.
· Collaboration and adaptability: comfort working across multidisciplinary teams, learning new domains quickly, and contributing beyond a narrow specialism.
· Structured problem solving: the ability to break down ambiguity, identify options, build evidence-based recommendations, and move work forward.
Experience across several of these areas:
Candidates should bring experience in some of the areas below and demonstrate a willingness to build broader capability across multiple domains. These are the kinds of things our teams do; they are not all mandatory requirements for every candidate.
· Technology strategy and architecture: shaping technology vision, business technology strategy, enterprise architecture, future-state roadmaps, and investment cases.
· AI, data, and digital foundations: supporting AI adoption, data strategy, agentic or AI-enabled platforms, cloud and infrastructure strategies, enterprise SaaS, and modern digital core design.
· Technology modernisation and resilience: assessing legacy estates, defining modernisation pathways, improving resilience, and sequencing practical architecture roadmaps.
· Technology effectiveness and value: improving technology operating models, FinOps, cost optimisation, AI-enabled software delivery, engineering productivity, and value tracking.
· Transformation delivery: supporting large-scale technology programmes, transformation offices, governance, planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realisation.
· Ecosystem and platform collaboration: working with major technology platforms, cloud providers, software vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams to shape integrated solutions.
Who will thrive in this role:
· Generalists who enjoy connecting ideas across strategy, architecture, delivery, AI, data, operating model, and business value.
· People who are comfortable with ambiguity and can help clients move from broad ambition to practical next steps.
· Consultants who are comfortable working collaboratively with clients and teams, communicating clearly and contributing positively to shared outcomes
· Candidates with curiosity , learning agility, and the confidence to contribute across several areas while deepening expertise over time.
Important note on requirements
This is intentionally not a checklist of mandatory must-haves. We expect candidates to demonstrate the core consulting, communication, AI awareness, project, and change skills described above, and to bring meaningful experience across several of the capability areas. We welcome candidates who can learn quickly, collaborate broadly, and apply good judgement across a range of client challenges.

Level and typical responsibilities

Job Description
Who You’ll Work With
The AI Strategist and Management Consultant partners with clients and internal leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled transformation opportunities. The role translates business strategy into an actionable portfolio of AI initiatives, aligns leaders around the investment case and operating model, and supports implementation through adoption and value realization.
What You’ll Do
· Lead strategy and transformation workstreams that connect AI, data, and automation opportunities to enterprise priorities, customer needs, and measurable business outcomes.
· Facilitate executive and cross-functional workshops to define strategic questions, diagnose current-state capabilities, and align on decisions, risks, and next steps.
· Develop AI opportunity portfolios, use-case assessments, roadmaps, operating-model recommendations, and investment cases that are practical and outcome-oriented.
· Quantify expected value, delivery effort, dependencies, and risk to help leaders prioritize investments and sequence initiatives.

· Advise on responsible AI, governance, model risk, data quality, privacy, and change-management considerations throughout the transformation lifecycle.
· Create executive-ready analyses, narratives, and recommendations that make complex topics clear and support timely decisions.
· Support delivery teams from pilot through scale by tracking outcomes, removing strategic blockers, and evolving the roadmap based on learning and results.
· Contribute to account growth through trusted client relationships, proposal development, thought leadership, and identification of follow-on opportunities.
· Coach junior team members and model high standards for problem solving, collaboration, and client service. What Success Looks Like
Timeframe
Indicative outcomes
First 90 days
Build trusted relationships, understand priority client or business contexts, and lead defined analyses or workstreams with strong quality and pace.
Six months
Shape clear AI strategies and business cases, facilitate productive leadership sessions, and help teams move priority initiatives into delivery.
Twelve months
Own major workstreams or smaller engagements, demonstrate measurable client impact, and contribute to repeatable offerings, account growth, and team development. ​

· 5+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business transformation, AI strategy, product strategy, analytics consulting, or a closely related field.

jd_text:
ICF is a leading provider of science-based climate, environmental and energy advisory services to private and public sector clients across the globe. We help our clients progress on their transformation journey, from the understanding of this rapidly evolving landscape to the design and implementation of impactful strategies and actions plans all the way to their evaluation.
To support the continued growth of our Sustainable Finance, Climate and Biodiversity Policy practice, we are looking for experienced Senior Consultants to join our team in Brussels, Spain or London. The successful candidate will join a dynamic team and support our diverse policy work. You will get the opportunity to work on flagship projects such as the Innovation Fund, studies related to climate diplomacy, and the transformation of our society towards a net-zero, nature positive and socially just model. Your work will benefit clients such as the European Commission, national governments, and international and national development finance institutions.
Our team has built a reputation for the successful delivery of large, complex projects, developing innovative solutions that drive positive change for their clients and support the overall sustainable transition in the EU and beyond.
Some of our flagship projects include:
· Providing continuous expertise since 2019 to support the successful implementation of the EU Emissions Trading System’s Innovation Fund
· Supporting the design of decarbonisation strategies and transition pathways at EU and national level
· Supporting the development of a long-term research and innovation agenda towards 2050 climate neutrality (see report here)
· Designing Sustainable Finance Action Plans for different EU Member States (e.g. Poland, Italy) to redirect public and private capitals towards the low carbon transition · Delivering the European Business and Biodiversity Platform since 2013 for the European Commission
· Evaluating the impact of green bonds on supporting climate mitigation investments for the European Investment Bank and European Bank for Reconstruction & Development
· Supporting National Promotional Banks in Poland and Spain with their sustainable finance strategies
Responsibilities:
You will work as part of a multi-national, multi-disciplinary and collaborative team of climate and environmental experts, economists, engineers, financial experts, and communication specialists to:
· · Support the delivery of projects for public and private clients
· Support the management of projects and take the lead in the deployment of discrete tasks and activities
· Provide robust and sound qualitative and quantitative analysis and support the translation of complex data into meaningful and impactful recommendations
· Engage with stakeholders through both quantitative and qualitative surveys
· Support ICF’s thought leadership in climate policy, identifying emerging trends and opportunities and help to translate these into new service offers that will benefit clients
Required qualifications & skills:
· Fluency in spoken English and excellent English writing skills
· Master’s degree in climate or environmental sciences, environmental economics, environmental engineering, political sciences, or a related discipline
· Professional working experience of at least 5 years in the field of climate policy at EU level, with an excellent understanding of the latest policy developments (e.g. Net Zero Industry Act; Climate Law; EU ETS; etc.).
· Demonstrable experience of public policy project delivery and management, and ideally with experience of conducting policy and programme evaluations
· Strong qualitative and quantitative analysis capability, including advanced knowledge of Excel and equivalent tools
· Proven communication skills and track record in the field of stakeholder engagement, especially within public authorities and the business and finance community
· Ability to work independently as well as within multi-cultural, multi-disciplinary consulting teams spread across several countries and time zones
Preferred qualifications & skills
· Fluency in a second EU language
· Entrepreneurial mindset eager to innovate and develop new solutions to address the climate and environmental crises.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.
We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
As a team:
Our National Security team is a successful, growing and high-performing part of our Public Sector Strategy & Consulting practice. Within the practice, you will work on innovative projects with colleagues and clients to drive excellence from strategy through to implementation, making changes that directly impact citizens. You will be using the latest technologies and methodologies with clients to help them achieve tangible outcomes and accelerate value.
We work closely with cutting-edge research and development, major hyperscalers, and leading technology players, bringing the best of Accenture’s partnerships and innovation ecosystem to solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Do you want to work in an environment that is cutting-edge, collaborative and challenging, doing work that really matters?
You'll learn, grow and advance in a collaborative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. At Accenture, you can truly take control of your own career.
If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you.
In our team you will learn:
· How to develop and deliver solutions to real world problems, partnering with clients to achieve positive outcomes through collaboration
· How to maximise the use of data in everything you do, using this data to drive solutions and tell meaningful stories to our clients
· How to lead with user-centricity at the heart of our work
As a Management Consultant, you will:
· Work on projects to transform the Workforce across our National Security clients
· Lead complex, people-centric transformation workstreams to drive business change, integrating across large multi-disciplinary programme teams and providing leadership on the people side of the solution/ implementation.
· Be the face of Accenture to the client in your engagements, working with senior stakeholders to advise, challenge and coach as needed
· Develop detailed understanding of your client’s business and drive issue-based discussions grounded in a clear understanding of client challenges and barriers.
· Cultivate trust-based client relationships
· Identify and address client business issues through root cause analysis and by applying pragmatic, results-driven problem-solving techniques and creative insights.
· Use a human-centred approach to solve problems, frame opportunities, and achieve innovation through collaboration and co-creation
· Contribute to business development and sales, working with account teams to scope opportunities and developing compelling proposals to win new work
We are looking for experience in the following skills:
The most important thing for us is that you display the right attitude. We would like you to actively contribute to our community and clients as practitioners, grow our practice, think logically to tackle problems and engage others. We want you to be driven to develop yourself and others, an ability to see and articulate the bigger picture of how individual projects and deliverables create value for citizens and a passion for innovation and the latest technology trends. This role will require creative thinking, excellent client communication skills and the ability to identify new innovative ways to apply our skills and services to solve a wider set of client problems.
As well as the above, you should have experience in more than one of the following areas:
· A minimum of 2-5 years’ people consulting experience in a National Security environment
· Analytical problem-solving skills and continuous improvement techniques
· Strategic thinking skills and the ability to bring insight to complex problems
· Designing and/or implementing operating models/ organisation design
· Change management
· Leadership Development
· Culture Advisory
· Workforce Transformation
· Experience of working with National Security clients
· Experience identifying growth opportunities
· Ability to operate at all stages of a project/programme lifecycle, from proposal through to full programme delivery, and experience managing risks and working with senior client partners.
· Working with data in the design or delivery of consulting services in National Security
· Working with technology to design or deliver transformation in National Security
· Strong interpersonal skills
Set yourself apart:
· In-depth understanding of the National Security landscapes you have worked in
· Experience in owning and managing relationships with leadership (either with your clients or internal stakeholders)
· Trained in Change Management or Agile methodologies, programme or project management techniques (e.g. Prince 2, Managing Successful Programmes) and/or a Design Thinking practitioner
· Exposure to a current technology (e.g. a Cloud platform, a CRM platform)
· PowerPoint and Excel skills
What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!
Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jd_text:
TLDR: You would help the world's most important technology and AI companies execute their most critical transformations. You will be joining a team where you can build a career as a true industry leader and drive lasting, measurable impact on the market every day.
We Are:
Software, AI, advertising platforms, and hyperscalers are rewriting every industry and we help the companies doing the rewriting turn their strategy into results. We are the industry consultants and advisors for the world's most consequential technology companies: hyperscalers building the infrastructure that powers the global economy, software platforms reinventing how they grow and compete, and AI-native companies building an entirely new category.
Our clients need someone who can make everything they envision happen with speed and at scale. We work on the hardest execution challenges in tech industry today. How do you roll out a new AI-powered operating model across a 50,000-person organization? How do you stand up data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand without blowing cost targets? How do you drive adoption of a new platform when the business keeps moving? Our work generally focuses on four domains:
· Product & Go to Market | inclusive of building, launching, and scaling products; driving forward-deployed engagements to embed the customer in the product; managing enablement; executing go-to-market transformation and monetization initiatives at speed and scale
· Platform Services | shifting platforms from manual operations to Data & AI-powered services; implementing the operating models and processes that maximize trust, growth, and efficiency at billion-user scale
· AI Compute Capabilities | inclusive of helping companies build and operate AI infrastructure efficiently; executing data center delivery programs, driving utilization and ROI across the full lifecycle, and managing cost takeout opportunities across the business
· Transformation + Value | inclusive of executing end-to-end reinvention across mega-processes; delivering the programs that make AI adoption real; measuring and capturing value across the enterprise; and orchestrating the industry focus around customer zero
You Are:
A consultant with real experience inside or alongside the tech industry and the operational instincts to match. You know how to take a strategy and make it work in practice. You understand the gap between a good plan and a plan that gets implemented, and you close it.
You are energized by complexity, comfortable in fast-moving environments, and skilled at getting organizations to move. You define and track market trends while helping your clients outpace them through disciplined execution and sustained operational change. You build trust with clients that lasts beyond a single engagement, hold yourself and your team to a high bar on delivery, and show up every day focused on driving clear, measurable impact.
The Work:
· Translate strategies and roadmaps into action; building the implementation plans, workstreams, and operating models that make transformation real for technology companies.
· Drive execution directly alongside client teams; removing barriers, managing stakeholders, and making sure initiatives land with lasting impact rather than sitting in a deck.
· Size the value at stake for transformation initiatives and track delivery against it; helping clients understand and capture the ROI of the work in real time.
· Execute on cost reduction and efficiency opportunities across client operations; including AI-related spend, infrastructure utilization, and process overhead.
· Develop client-ready materials that communicate progress, decisions, and recommendations clearly to executive stakeholders.
· Structure and lead workstreams from start to finish; designing the approach, managing the work, and delivering outputs that are ready for the client without a second pass.
· Own quality across everything the team produces. Coherence, rigor, and client-readiness are the standard.
· Support business development; contributing to proposals, shaping the point of view on new opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships.
· Develop junior team members; give honest feedback, create real ownership opportunities, and invest in their growth.
· Travel: Average 40–50% (up to 80% as needed).
Here's What You Need:
· A bachelor's degree.
· Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the tech industry or consulting.
Bonus Points If:
· You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
· Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
· A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
· Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems.
· Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
· Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

jd_text:
We Are:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at accenture.com.
Our AI and Data practice sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge and applied AI and data engineering. We help the world’s leading Resources and Utilities organizations reinvent how they run — designing the data foundations, AI platforms, and governance models that turn data into trusted, production-grade intelligence. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI in the abstract. We need practitioners who understand how enterprises actually operate, where the friction lives, and how to engineer smarter solutions using AI and data to fundamentally transform business processes and outcomes.
You Are:
You are a Data Strategy & Governance Consultant who executes the design and operationalization of enterprise data governance frameworks. You thrive on the hands-on work of building stewardship processes, authoring data policies, and configuring governance tooling so that data is trusted, well-managed, and ready for analytics and AI. You partner closely with business and technology stakeholders and turn governance concepts into working reality.

Junior Consultant Customer Transformation (frog)
Bij frog, onderdeel van Capgemini Invent, helpen we organisaties zichzelf opnieuw uit te vinden voor de eco-digitale toekomst. Door creativiteit, strategie, design en technologie samen te brengen, creëren we onderscheidende ervaringen die groei stimuleren én positieve impact maken op mens, organisatie en planeet. Samen met onze klanten ontwikkelen we innovatieve oplossingen die uitdagingen van vandaag én morgen aanpakken.Uren: 40 uurLocatie: Utrecht, bij de opdrachtgever op locatie en remoteErvaringsniveau: Junior (minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring)Startdatum: November/decemberWat ga je doen als Junior Consultant Customer Transformation?Als Junior Consultant Customer Transformation help je organisaties om klantgerichte transformaties te realiseren. Je start vanuit de behoeften van de eindgebruiker en vertaalt inzichten uit onderzoek, data en workshops naar concrete oplossingen die klanten, medewerkers en organisaties vooruithelpen. Je werkt aan vraagstukken op het snijvlak van customer experience, service design, marketingtechnologie, AI en digitale transformatie.In deze rol werk je aan:Het ontwikkelen van klantgerichte strategieën en omnichannel oplossingen voor organisaties in onder meer retail, financiële dienstverlening en de publieke sector.Het analyseren van klantbehoeften met behulp van marktonderzoek, klantonderzoek, data-analyse en co-creatie workshops om verbeterkansen te identificeren.Het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe klantreizen, service blueprints, AI-gedreven customer experience strategieën, marketingtechnologie-oplossingen en digitale proposities voor toonaangevende organisaties. Voorbeelden zijn het lanceren van nieuwe verkoopkanalen, het implementeren van marketingtechnologieën en het ontwerpen van end-to-end klantbelevingen voor banken, verzekeraars en publieke instellingen.Let op: voor deze functie is beheersing van de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau vereist. Win hearts. Move markets. Create the future.Ready to make your mark?Jouw profielJe hebt:Een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding in bijvoorbeeld Strategic product design, Business, Innovation, Transformation, Marketing, Design, Data of AI.Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring en affiniteit met strategieontwikkeling rondom digitale klantbeleving en customer experience.Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden waarmee je complexe informatie vertaalt naar begrijpelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen.Ervaring of affiniteit met design thinking, klantonderzoek, marketingactivatie, projectmanagement, marketingtechnologie (bij voorkeur Adobe en Salesforce) en AI-gerelateerde toepassingen.Je maakt bewust gebruik van AI-tools, beoordeelt output kritisch en staat open voor het continu ontwikkelen van nieuwe kennis en vaardigheden binnen een snel veranderende technologische omgeving.Deze criteria geven een indicatie van het profiel dat we zoeken. Voldoe je niet aan alle criteria maar denk je wel dat dit de juiste functie voor jou is, dan nodigen we je van harte uit om toch te solliciteren of contact op te nemen.Wat bieden wij jou?Direct een vast contract vanaf dag één met een startsalaris van €2.950 bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.Een mobiliteitsvergoeding van €800 bruto per maand met de keuze voor een leaseauto, NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding.26 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra verlofdagen bij te kopen.Uitgebreide Learning & Development mogelijkheden via de Capgemini Academy, certificeringen, digitale leerplatforms en de nieuwste AI-trainingen en tools.Deelname aan The Institute, een intensief opleidingsprogramma van twee maanden waarin je consultancyvaardigheden ontwikkelt door middel van praktijkopdrachten, coaching en feedback.Persoonlijke begeleiding, coaching en ondersteuning voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke groei.Flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en een connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding die jouw work-life balance ondersteunen.Een volledig door de werkgever betaald pensioen, met de mogelijkheid om zelf extra bij te dragen.Een laptop en simkaart die je zowel zakelijk als privé mag gebruiken.De mogelijkheid om samen te werken met een wereldwijd netwerk van experts en op termijn internationale ervaring op te doen. Interesse? Solliciteer direct online met je CV & motivatiebrief waarin je ons laat zien welke relevante ervaring/skills jij meebrengt op het gebied van CX/Marketing/Tech/Design en waarom jij bij frog wilt werken! We kijken uit naar je reactie!Jouw werkomgevingJe maakt onderdeel uit van een team van ruim 40 klantgerichte strategen in de Utrechtse studio van frog. Binnen het team werk je samen met designers, creatieven, marketeers, consultants en technologie-experts die organisaties helpen hun klantbeleving, proposities en dienstverlening te transformeren. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot een wereldwijd netwerk van meer dan 2.000 frogs en de brede expertise van Capgemini Invent.Bij Capgemini Invent geloven we dat verschil verandering mogelijk maakt. Als transformatieconsultants combineren we strategie, creativiteit, data en technologie om complexe uitdagingen van vandaag én morgen op te lossen. Samen met onze klanten ontwikkelen we innovatieve oplossingen die worden onderbouwd door wetenschap, versterkt door AI en tot leven gebracht door design. Zo realiseren we duurzame impact die ertoe doet.Kom kennismaken tijdens één van onze eventsBenieuwd naar de cultuur, werkwijze en carrièremogelijkheden binnen Capgemini? Tijdens onze events maak je kennis met collega's, hoor je hun persoonlijke ervaringen en krijg je een kijkje achter de schermen. Bekijk onze evenementenpagina voor een overzicht van de aankomende events in Utrecht Leidsche Rijn.Recruiter contactgegevensWil je meer weten over de rol, het team of de mogelijkheden? Danique Tiggelaven vertelt je er graag meer over.Danique TiggelavenDanique.tiggelaven@capgemini.comOm de veiligheid en integriteit binnen onze organisatie te borgen, maakt een backgroundcheck onderdeel uit van het onboardingsproces.Over CapgeminiCapgemini is een wereldwijd opererende partner in bedrijfs- en technologische transformatie, gedreven door AI, die aantoonbare bedrijfswaarde levert. Met de kracht van AI, generatieve AI, cloud, data en technologie helpen we organisaties hun digitale en duurzame ambities waar te maken. Dankzij onze expertise, onze end-to-end diensten en oplossingen, ondersteund door diepgaande sectorkennis en een sterk partner-ecosysteem, creëren we samen met meer dan 420.000 collega’s wereldwijd oplossingen die leiden tot blijvende waarde en tastbare impact. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Description
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
Our valuation and modelling services are focused on the areas of Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), Contentious Valuations, Complex Financial Instruments, Financial and Tax reporting and Business Modelling. Employees are rewarded for their contribution to growing both the Valuations business and A&M. We are unrestricted by conflicts with audit mandates, which allows us to operate seamlessly across borders and deliver exceptional client service.
How You Will Contribute
· Build and maintain valuation models using income, market, and asset-based approaches (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions)
· Research and compile financial data on companies, industries, and market transactions
· Analyse historical financial statements and prepare normalization adjustments
· Calculate discount rates, including WACC, cost of equity, and size or company-specific premiums
· Support purchase price allocations, goodwill impairment testing, and intangible asset valuations
· Prepare sections of valuation reports, client presentations, and supporting workpapers
· Perform quality checks on data, formulas, and outputs, and document assumptions clearly
· Respond to client and reviewer questions, and assist with information requests
· Contribute to internal initiatives, such as business development activities, creating templates, benchmarks, and knowledge-sharing
· Collaborate with internal teams and external advisors to ensure timely and high-quality deliverables
· Contribute to the development of insights and recommendations for clients under the guidance of Managers and Directors
Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline
· 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in corporate finance, transaction advisory, investment banking, valuation, or financial consulting
· Strong financial modeling and valuation skills with a solid understanding of corporate finance concepts
· High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial databases is an advantage
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
· Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a deadline-driven environment
· Professional qualifications (e.g., CFA, CPA, CA, MBA) are an advantage but not required
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

jd_text:
Job Family :

Travel Required :
Up to 50%

Ability to Obtain Public Trust
What You Will Do:
Guidehouse's Public Sector Health team is seeking a Senior Consultant to support federal clients oversight, monitoring, and program integrity activities for block grant programs. This role supports targeted oversight and monitoring activities designed to help identify, assess, and address program integrity risks outside routine monitoring cycles. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills with experience working with federal grants programs, monitoring and oversight processes, and program integrity-related activities. Successful clients will work collaboratively with clients and project teams to with federal staff, grant recipients, and project teams to assess risks, conduct monitoring activities, develop actionable recommendations, and support program accountability and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
· Support federal clients in conducting targeted oversight and monitoring activities for federal grants programs.
· Review significant audit findings, recipient responses, corrective-action plans, internal control documentation, and supporting records to assess programmatic and operational risks.
· Conduct targeted remote and onsite monitoring activities in response to significant findings, emerging risks, allegations, or other program integrity concerns.
· Assess policies, procedures, program operations, oversight practices, internal controls, and supporting documentation to identify potential risks and monitoring concerns.
· Evaluate the status and effectiveness of corrective actions and support follow-up activities to address unresolved monitoring findings.
· Assist in the inventory, analysis, prioritization, and closure of aged monitoring findings and corrective-action items.
· Analyze trends across monitoring findings, control deficiencies, allegations, referrals, audit results, and other risk indicators to identify recurring or emerging concerns.
· Develop monitoring reports, findings summaries, executive briefings, presentations, recommendations, and other client deliverables.
· Collaborate with federal, state, local, nonprofit, and other grant-recipient stakeholders to gather information, discuss observations, and support monitoring activities.

jd_text:
Utilities Consultant - Power Systems
Career Level 9: Consultant
Business Area: Utilities
Location: Dublin/Cork
Hybrid working
Do you want to contribute to work with meaningful impact and help Ireland achieve its sustainability and energy transition goals? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking an experienced professional to work with leading Utilities companies, collaborating to transform their businesses and revolutionise the energy landscape. Join us in driving climate action and working on new and innovative solutions to meet the challenges of today and tomorrow.
Ireland's Utilities sector is at the heart of the energy transition, and the decisions being made now on networks, renewables, markets and customers will shape the country for decades. As a Consultant in Accenture's Utilities practice, you'll work on nationally significant engagements with Ireland's leading energy, gas and water organisations. You'll help them decarbonise, invest in resilient infrastructure and deliver more sustainable, affordable services, while building and developing a high-performing team.
Apply now and become an integral part of the movement towards a cleaner, greener future.
Accenture Utilities
At Accenture, we deliver end-to-end solutions that drive real change for organisations. You'll work on innovative projects with dedicated colleagues, using the latest technologies and innovations to help clients achieve their goals, from digital disruption to sustainable net-zero transition. As part of our global network, you'll use a broad range of expertise to tackle our clients' most ambitious problems and directly contribute to the energy transition. We'll support your continuous development of market-relevant knowledge, advisory, and technical skills, challenging you to take on new initiatives and push the boundaries of what's possible.
Join our Utilities Industry Practice within Industry & Enterprise, where we help Ireland's leading utilities companies achieve their climate action targets. Bring your passion and experience to deliver ground-breaking projects, whether in electricity power system operations or sophisticated program delivery. You'll support clients with a range of services, from industry consulting, strategic direction, to process improvement and technology transformations, while building your skills and driving energy transition goals.
Job Description:
As a Consultant in Utilities, you will play a key role in delivering impactful advisory and transformation engagements for Ireland's leading energy and utilities organisations. A key element of your role is to apply deep sector and delivery experience of power system planning, network operations and grid infrastructure alongside strong analytical capability to diagnose client challenges, develop practical recommendations, and support their implementation. Working closely with client stakeholders, you will build trusted relationships, provide strategic guidance, and contribute to solutions that address complex challenges across grid stability, network capacity and the infrastructure requirements of the energy transition. You will work as part of cross-functional teams, contributing to workstream delivery and ensuring outcomes are aligned to client goals and the broader energy transition agenda.
Key Responsibilities:
· Support the delivery of strategic initiatives for utilities clients, helping to meet their decarbonisation, resilience and sustainability objectives.
· Support the delivery of high-quality consulting engagements and transformation programmes across the utilities sector.
· Contribute to and collaborate within multi-functional project teams, coordinating workstream activities across the engagement lifecycle.
· Apply expertise in power system planning, network analysis and grid operations to support the design and implementation of solutions for utilities clients.
· Support resource planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities within the context of the engagement or programme
· Contribute to integrated project and programme planning, ensuring coherent workstream coordination across engagements.
· Identify and escalate risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, supporting their effective management throughout the engagement.
· Prepare and present clear, structured analysis, and insights for client and internal stakeholders.
· Collaborate with client teams, subject matter experts, and colleagues across business, technology, and operations functions to ensure alignment on goals and outcomes.
· Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, developing a deep understanding of their challenges to ensure our recommendations and solutions address their needs.
· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, bringing fresh thinking to enhance the efficiency, quality, and impact of client engagements.
· Continuously develop and maintain deep expertise across the utilities sector to provide informed guidance to clients and contribute to Accenture’s utilities thought leadership.
· Support business development activities including solution scoping, proposal development, and client presentations to help grow Accenture's utilities practice.
Desired skillset: ·
· Experience working within or consulting to the utilities sector.
· Experience in delivery of complex projects or programmes within a power systems, grid infrastructure, or network operations environment. ·
· Knowledge of power systems operations, including transmission network design, grid stability and system balancing. ·
· Familiarity with grid connection processes, network codes and regulatory frameworks. ·
· Excellent communication, and interpersonal skills. ·
· Ability to communicate findings and status to a non-technical audience. ·
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. ·
· Experience leveraging AI and data-driven tools to analyse complex problems, generate insights, or develop solutions that drive measurable value for clients.
· Experience working independently and in diverse teams.
· Focus on continuous development and curiosity about the latest industry and technology trends.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE : ·
· Relevant undergraduate/master’s degree in a business, engineering, technical or economic field.
· 4-7 years of relevant utility proven experience in power system planning, network operations, grid infrastructure, or a related technical discipline, or 3-5 years in a consulting role, with experience in power systems or network transformation engagements.
· Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment across a wide variety of projects and roles to deliver for our clients.
· Ability to build lasting relationships with clients and colleagues.
· Previous experience working within the Utilities (electricity, gas, water) sector would be beneficial #LI-EU
. Does this appeal to you? If so, we wish to hear from you.

A key element of your role is to apply deep sector and delivery experience of wholesale energy, trading, settlement, and regulatory frameworks alongside analytical capability to diagnose client challenges, develop practical recommendations, and support their implementation. Working closely with client stakeholders, you will build trusted relationships, provide strategic guidance, and contribute to solutions that address complex challenges across energy markets and regulation. You will work as part of cross-functional teams, contributing to workstream delivery and ensuring outcomes are aligned to client goals and the broader energy transition agenda.
Key Responsibilities:
· Support the delivery of strategic initiatives for utilities clients, helping to meet their decarbonisation, resilience and sustainability objectives.
· Support the delivery of high-quality consulting engagements and transformation programmes across the utilities sector.
· Contribute to and collaborate within multi-functional project teams, coordinating workstream activities across the engagement lifecycle.
· Apply expertise in energy market design, wholesale trading, balancing mechanisms or settlement processes to support the design and implementation of solutions for utilities clients.
· Support resource planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities within the context of the engagement or programme
· Contribute to integrated project and programme planning, ensuring coherent workstream coordination across engagements.
· Identify and escalate risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, supporting their effective management throughout the engagement.
· Prepare and present clear, structured analysis, and insights for client and internal stakeholders.
· Collaborate with client teams, subject matter experts, and colleagues across business, technology, and operations functions to ensure alignment on goals and outcomes.
· Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, developing a deep understanding of their challenges to ensure our recommendations and solutions address their needs.
· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, bringing fresh thinking to enhance the efficiency, quality, and impact of client engagements.
· Continuously develop and maintain deep expertise across the utilities sector to provide informed guidance to clients and contribute to Accenture’s utilities thought leadership.
· Support business development activities including solution scoping, proposal development, and client presentations to help grow Accenture's utilities practices
Desired skillset:
· Experience working within or consulting to the utilities sector.
· Experience in delivery of complex projects or programmes within an energy markets, trading or regulatory environment.
· Knowledge of wholesale electricity market structures, including energy market design, balancing markets and settlement processes.
· Familiarity with energy market regulation and policy frameworks.
· Excellent communication, and interpersonal skills.
· Ability to communicate findings and status to a non-technical audience.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
· Experience leveraging AI and data-driven tools to analyse complex problems, generate insights, or develop solutions that drive measurable value for clients.
· Experience working independently and in diverse teams.
· Focus on continuous development and curiosity about the latest industry and technology trends.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE : ·
· Relevant undergraduate/master’s degree in a business, engineering, technical or economic field.
· 4-7 years of relevant utility proven experience in energy market operations, market design, regulatory policy, or trading environments, or 3-5 years in a consulting role, with experience in energy market engagements.
· Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment across a wide variety of projects and roles to deliver for our clients.
· Ability to build lasting relationships with clients and colleagues.
· Previous experience working within the Utilities (electricity, gas, water) sector would be beneficial. #LI-EU

jd_text:
Job Family :
Finance & Accounting Consulting
Travel Required :
Up to 10%
Clearance Required :
Ability to Obtain Public Trust
What You Will Do :
Our Financial Management Transformation professionals help our clients in Defense and National Security optimize all elements of their financial management structure by transforming business processes, enhancing operational efficiency, improving transparency and performance management, promoting change management, and complying with Federal laws and regulations.
The nature of our projects is extremely fluid and requires self-motivated individuals who are willing to develop solutions on their own or in a team of highly skilled professionals. Project members are provided the opportunity to interact with our client’s senior management, and to enhance their skills in technical competency, business development, client service, and people development. Our team provides specialized experience and knowledge in financial management, process analysis, risk management, and performance measurement to support project activities.
Specific initiatives and work products that this role supports include:
· Supporting transformative initiatives by collaborating with team members to partner with senior stakeholders to modernize financial processes through innovative solutions
· Leading the implementation of Microsoft 365 Power Platform tools, including Power Apps solutions, and presenting solutions to stakeholders for iterative feedback
· Creating performance metrics and interactive dashboards utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, Power Platform, SharePoint, Power BI, and more
· Identifying and implementing process improvements over financial tools and templates, and using technology to improve financial management
· Assessing existing business processes and procedures to identify pain points and areas for improvement. This includes coordination with process stakeholders to complete current-state assessments, review of relevant documentation to gain a thorough understanding, and evaluation and recommendation of future-state solutions
· Assisting in the creation of project plans to support the execution of end-to-end development efforts and ensuring that realistic timelines are set, communicated, and followed through, barring any significant holdups
· Communicating project task updates to senior-level executive clients on a regular basis and confirming shared understanding
· Collaborating with senior team members to embed financial management standards into the design and development of solutions, ensuring alignment with federal financial policies, audit readiness, and operational integrity
· Coordinating with other team members and/or building necessary skills to develop financial automation, data analytics, data visualization, and/or artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities for financial management use cases. This may include: building financial metrics and supporting dashboards utilizing data visualization software (i.e., Tableau, Power BI, etc.); building low-code applications and user interfaces (using PowerApps, Power Platforms, Appian, ServiceNow, etc.); building AI models to process and analyze high volumes of structured and unstructured financial data (using Databricks, Snowflake, Palantir, Python, R, SQL, etc.).
What You Will Need :
· Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
· Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, information systems, engineering, business analytics, or a related field
· TWO (2) years of experience in business transformation, financial management, data analytics, audit or accounting. Experience must include:
· Experience with low-code and no-code technology platforms, including SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Tableau
· Heightened attention to detail, and the ability to create and edit technical and non-technical written work products and graphical presentations
· Experience Leading client meetings and presenting recommendations to senior-level leadership
· Experience utilizing project management best practices
· Experience documenting and evaluating business processes and making recommendations for process improvements
What Would Be Nice To Have :
· Master’s degree preferably in Business Analytics
· Certifications in Agile, Scrum, or project management (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe) and/or strong understanding of these concepts, or interest in obtaining these certifications
· Experience analyzing data using programming tools such as Python, R, SQL, and Databricks
· Familiarity or proficiency with cloud platforms, such as AWS or Azure
· Ability to develop insightful visualizations using Tableau, PowerBI or Qlik
· Experience with change management or organizational design, especially in financial environments
· Desire and ability to quickly develop an overall technical skillset related to analytics and automation to apply and tailor to the specific needs of clients and the mission of their organizations
The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.
What We Offer :
Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
Benefits include:
· Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance
· Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays
· Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus
· Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance
· 401(k) Retirement Plan
· Basic Life & Supplemental Life
· Health Savings Account, Dental/Vision & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
· Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
· Student Loan PayDown
· Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development & Learning Opportunities
· Skills Development & Certifications
· Employee Referral Program
· Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach
· Emergency Back-Up Childcare Program
· Mobility Stipend

jd_text:
We Are:
Accenture Song’s Utilities team, a group of management consultants helping leading organizations reinvent service as a driver of customer trust, operational efficiency, and satisfaction. We help clients move beyond traditional cost-focused service models by defining future-ready customer service strategies, operating models, transformation roadmaps, and business cases that connect human-centered design, data-driven insights, AI, and scalable technology platforms.
Within Utilities, we work with electricity, gas & water providers to address rising customer expectations, affordability pressures, regulatory requirements, outage and emergency communications, energy transition programs, and the need for proactive, personalized, digital-first engagement. We help clients modernize customer care, improve satisfaction and trust, reduce cost to serve, and unlock new value through different service models, automation, analytics, and connected customer experiences.
You Are:
A Management Consultant who understands how exceptional service experiences are designed, operated, measured, and transformed. You bring a strategic yet tactical & deployment mindset, strong analytical skills, and practical experience helping organizations assess current-state service performance, identify & evaluate breakpoints, define & deploy future-state visions, and create & execute roadmaps that improve customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
You are passionate about the Utilities industry and understand the critical moments that shape customer trust, including billing, payments, collections, outage management, move-in/move-out, field service coordination, energy efficiency, rate changes, distributed energy resources, and clean energy adoption. You understand these industry dynamics and work with cross-functional and technical teams to deploy tactics that balance customer expectations, regulatory considerations, operational realities, and business value.
You are comfortable working across strategy, functional, and technology teams to shape and deploy recommendations that are both innovative and achievable. You have the consulting toolbelt and bring multi-faceted skills to the workplace, including the abilities to engage client leaders & stakeholders, facilitate workshops, synthesize customer and operational insights, build compelling narratives, guide clients into making confident decisions on where and how to transform service and partner with clients to deploy & monitor various initiatives
You are energized by the opportunity to ideate & deploy automation, AI, Agentic AI and Agentic Commerce solutions to reinvent the end-to-end Utilities Customer processes, across channels and across the front- and back-office.
Travel may be required for this role, varying from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
Here's what you need:
· Minimum of 4 years of Strategy or Management consulting experience focused on helping organizations reimagine customer service, customer support, contact center operations, back-office delivery (billing, payments, credit & collections) or digital customer engagement. Including:
· Minimum of 4 years of experience creating & implementing experience design, data‑driven insights, and analytics into service transformation to improve customer outcomes and reduce cost‑to‑serve
· Minimum of 4 years of deep functional expertise across one or more key customer service domains:
· Customer & field service transformation (front- and/or back-office focused on the customer)
· Customer experience design and journey management
· Operating model and process redesign
· Workforce, forecasting, and service model transformation
· Quality and performance management frameworks
· Technology enablement strategy (e.g. IVR, digital platforms, routing, analytics)
· KPI architecture, insights, and measurement strategy
· Vendor and ecosystem strategy for service delivery
· Experience evaluating benchmarking data and competitive insights (customer, operational, and financial) to identify breakpoints, size opportunities, and shape strategic recommendations across channels (web, chat, email, social).
· Experience implementing distinct service initiatives within a Customer roadmap to uplift operational performance, enhance customer satisfaction and reduce cost to serve
· Demonstrated ability to conduct assessment‑to‑strategy-to-implementation engagements, translate findings into actionable recommendations, and lead implementation of strategic initiatives that drive measurable customer, operational, or financial impact.
· Exposure & understanding of how applying AI and digital engagement capabilities to elevate customer interactions—such as conversational AI, virtual agents, intelligent routing, and predictive tools—within broader service strategy frameworks.
· Minimum of 1 year of experience serving utilities clients (electric, gas, or water) or in a utilities finance, controllership, or regulatory function.
· Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 4 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 5-year work experience
Bonus points if:
· You have past experience leveraging Cloud (SaaS) platforms to architect future‑state service models, assess technology fit within enterprise ecosystems, and inform CX transformation strategies.
· You have past experience advising clients on customer service technologies (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics, Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE) and how these platforms enable omnichannel service strategies and scalable operating models.
· You have past experience working with Customer Information Systems (CIS) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms to understand how these systems contribute to the Utilities value chain and where they play a role within the development and deployment of initiatives across Customer operations
· You have hands‑on experience with automation, AI, GenAI, and conversational design, with the ability to translate emerging capabilities into strategic customer experience roadmaps and future‑state operating models.
