jd_text:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
Insights & Analytics
ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
The role
A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 2–4 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.
This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.
What You’ll Do
· AI & analytics engineering (~60%)
· Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables → metric layer → signal detection → LLM narrative → application surface.
· Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
· Enforce guardrails in data and metadata — governed tables, SQL-level scope control — rather than in prompt instructions.
· Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
· Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
· Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
· Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked). Core commercial analytics (~40%)
· Take ambiguous questions from any client function — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations — and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
· Pick the method the question needs — diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation — and defend the choice.
· Work across the client's data estate — syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data — integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
· Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code — one definition, every surface.
· Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders. Client & team leadership
· Plan, review and coach a team of 2–4; QC everything before it reaches the client.
· Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
· Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building — reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.
What You’ll Bring
· A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
· 5 – 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
· SQL — expert. Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
· Python — production-grade. pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
· Lakehouse platform — Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
· LLM application engineering — Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
· Applied analytics — solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred — any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
· Consulting skills. Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
· People leadership. Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
· Fluency in English
· Client-first mentality
· Intense work ethic
· Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach How you’ll grow:
· Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
· Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
· Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions
Perks & Benefits:
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India , visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS .

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Support the development and execution of change, communications and adoption plans. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, operational and technical communities. As an Associate Consultant within Discovery Strategy & Transformation, you’ll help biotech and life sciences organizations solve complex challenges at the intersection of science, business, technology, and change. What You Will Do:
At Guidehouse, grants management is not a back-office compliance function—it’s where public dollars turn into real outcomes. Our team works at the center of some of the largest, most complex federal and state funding programs in the country, partnering directly with government leaders to design, launch, and sustain programs that matter—from healthcare access and community recovery to energy transition and infrastructure resilience.
You’ll join a team that combines deep technical credibility with strategic influence. We don’t just help clients comply with 2 CFR 200—we shape how programs are structured, governed, and delivered so they withstand scrutiny, adapt to shifting federal priorities, and produce measurable impact. Our consultants are trusted advisors, often embedded alongside agency leadership, helping translate policy into executable, audit defensible operations.
Guidehouse invests in how grants work tomorrow, not just how they worked yesterday. That includes modernizing grants operations with data, analytics, and AI enabled tools—while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and human judgment that public funding demands. You’ll have opportunities to innovate responsibly, build new solutions, and influence firmwide approaches to grants modernization.
Equally important, you’ll be part of a collaborative, mission driven culture. We value clarity, quality, and professionalism—and we support career paths that reward both subject matter depth and leadership. Whether you want to specialize deeply, lead large programs, or grow into broader advisory roles, Guidehouse provides the platform and trust to do meaningful work at scale.
If you’re looking for a place where your grants expertise is respected, your ideas shape outcomes, and your work has visible public value, this is that team.
As a Grants Management Consultant or Senior Consultant, you will support the design and implementation of federal grant projects for state and local government clients. You will support areas such as strategic planning, financial management, monitoring and compliance, and stakeholder engagement to provide full lifecycle grants management support. This role is an exciting opportunity to guide clients through transformative programs and to be a part of an impactful mission.
Specific responsibilities will include:
· Collaborate with state and local government clients to establish or enhance grants management processes and procedures across the entire grants lifecycle
· Help to identify and proactively address client needs by presenting potential solutions to challenges or issues
· Participate in client discussions and meetings
· Effectively and concisely communicate and present information to clients and leadership
· Develop agendas, meeting materials, and talking points in preparation for meetings
· Develop high-quality presentations that effectively communicate key objectives and facilitate discussion across multiple stakeholders
· Develop and ensure quality deliverables
· Participate in business development activities
· General project/task management
· Participate in internal and external grants management-related training, knowledge management, and thought leadership activities
What You Will Need:
· No sponsorship is available for this position
· Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university
· Minimum of ONE (1+) year of overall work experience for a consultant AND Minimum of THREE (3+) years overall work experience for a senior consultant,
· Experience in grants management for a senior consultant.
· Strong interest and aptitude supporting Grants Management work for Consultant level
· Strong understanding and expertise around Uniform Guidance – 2 CFR 200, including Single Audit requirements, and its application to different types of financial assistance to be considered for Senior Consultant level.
· Ability to quickly understand ongoing processes to develop and implement process improvements
· Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into tangible documents and/or deliverables
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of executives, managers, and subject matter experts
· Ability to identify and address client needs
· Advanced proficiency in the full Microsoft Suite, including MS Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel
· Demonstrated critical thinking skills
· Proven ability to work independently and collaborate with others
· Ability to organize, perform, and track multiple tasks accurately in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment
What Would Be Nice To Have:
· Prior experience helping to stand up or enhance full cycle grants management processes and procedures
· Prior experience in areas of risk management, internal controls, financial management, program management in state or local government
· Prior experience applying AI‑enabled tools and analytics to grants management functions, including opportunity identification, compliance monitoring, risk assessment, document review, or reporting, to improve efficiency, accuracy, and audit readiness across federal, state or local grant programs
· Grants Management certification from the National Grants Management Association or Management Concepts or other equivalent organizations
· Prior experience in supporting/performing grants management-related thought leadership/knowledge management actions – attending/organizing conferences/workshops, writing white papers and journal articles, etc.
· Prior experience performing business development actions

You will have the opportunity to develop client strategies, interfacing directly with clients and developing vendor relationships.

· Perform data analysis (example includes but is not limited to reviewing claims and utilization data and look for trends and patterns); may involve use of the Marsh's internal financial tools to develop self-funded claims projections, set rates and model employee cost-sharing scenarios
· Review internal compliance and client disclosure requirements, external vendor contracts, summary plan documents (SPD's) and employee communications to ensure alignment with client expectations and legal requirements
· Handle day-to-day client contact/account management to resolve project-related questions and challenges, and guide junior staff members in client interactions

jd_text:
Are you ready to be a part of the AI reinvention of industry and revolutionize your career?
In today’s world, our mission for AI reinvention is to be the leading reinvention partner for global enterprises by building a strong digital core and unleashing artificial intelligence to create 360° value at speed.
That’s where the Advanced Data & AI Center comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, data and AI practitioners, and technology specialists to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention.
Within the Global Center for AI & Data , the AI Trust, Ethics, and Safety team governs pre-deployment ethics and post-deployment operational oversight of AI systems. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to help organizations design, govern, and operate AI systems that are trustworthy, compliant, and fit for deployment across regulated and high-stakes environments.
WORK YOU’LL DO
As part of the Global Center for AI & Data , you will support clients in building the governance structures, regulatory frameworks, and operational controls needed to deploy AI responsibly.
As a Responsible AI Specialist , you will work at the intersection of AI governance, regulatory compliance, and AI system lifecycle management, helping clients translate regulatory obligations into implementable controls and embed responsible AI practices across their AI programmes.
You will work across AI regulatory compliance, AI risk methodology, governance operating model design, regulatory obligation mapping, and AI literacy, supporting both the design of governance frameworks and their integration into live AI development and deployment processes.
There will never be a typical day, and you will continuously learn and grow while working on innovative Data & AI initiatives across industries.
Key Responsibilities
· Map client AI systems against AI regulatory requirements, including prohibited practice identification, high-risk classification, conformity assessment obligations, and Article 4 AI literacy requirements.
· Design and implement AI governance operating models, including RACI structures, lifecycle gates, escalation pathways, and accountability frameworks tailored to the client’s organizational structure.
· Conduct AI risk assessments using structured methodologies, covering technical, legal, ethical, and operational risk dimensions across ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems.
· Support ISO/IEC 42001 readiness assessments and implementation planning, including gap analysis, controls design, and preparation for third-party certification.
· Develop regulatory obligation registers and translate them into actionable compliance requirements mapped to AI system components, roles, and processes.
· Configure and use AI governance platforms including IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, OneTrust, and ServiceNow to operationalize monitoring, audit trails, and compliance documentation.
· Design and deliver AI literacy programmes addressing Article 4 obligations, including role-based training content, competency frameworks, and delivery mechanisms.
· Support proposal development, client workshops, and governance design sessions as a technical subject matter contributor.
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
· Bachelor’s degree in Law, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is considered an advantage.
· 3+ years of relevant experience in AI governance, regulatory compliance, risk management, or a related area, with demonstrated hands-on exposure to AI system lifecycle practices and data or software engineering environments.
· Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, including its classification framework, conformity assessment requirements, and obligations for providers and deployers.
· Hands-on experience with one or more AI governance platforms: IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, OneTrust, ServiceNow, or SAS.
· Understanding of AI risk methodology applicable to ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems, including bias assessment, transparency requirements, and human oversight controls.
· Experience with agentic AI, including context engineering, agent memory patterns, or multi-agent solutions.
· Working knowledge of cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure) as they relate to AI system deployment and governance controls.
· Programming skills in Python, with experience integrating APIs and processing structured and unstructured information.
· Knowledge of GDPR and its intersection with AI system obligations, including data minimization, purpose limitation, and automated decision-making requirements.
· Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into operational controls and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
CONSIDERED A PLUS
· Experience with enterprise metadata and catalog platforms such as Alation, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or Informatica.
· Familiarity with data modelling and data architecture principles, with exposure to cloud data platforms
· Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 and its application to AI management system design and implementation.
· IAPP AIGP certification or active pursuit of it.
· ISO/IEC 42001 familiarity.
· Familiarity with DORA obligations as they apply to AI-driven financial systems.
· Experience with BPM tooling (Camunda) or workflow automation in compliance contexts.
· Relevant AI or cloud certifications, including Azure AI Fundamentals, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or equivalent.
· Exposure to security analysis practices (SAST, DAST, SCA) as applied to AI system assurance.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
· Competitive salary and benefits, including but not limited to: life/health insurance, performance based bonuses, monthly vouchers, company car (depending on management level), flexible work arrangements, employee share purchase plan, TEA Accenture, parental leave, paid overtime (if needed) and various corporate discounts
· Access to enterprise AI development tooling and the internal community building with it
· Continuous hard and soft skills training & development through global platforms & local academy, including cloud certification paths (Azure, GCP)
· Career coaching and mentorship to help you manage your career and develop professionally
· Ongoing strengths and skills based evaluation process
· Various opportunities to develop your career across a spectrum of clients, industries and projects
· Diverse and inclusive culture
· Corporate citizenship initiatives (access to volunteering opportunities, charity work etc.)
· Under our Brain Regain initiative, extra relocation benefits may apply
To learn more about Accenture, and how you will be challenged and inspired from Day 1, please visit our website accenture.com/gr-en/.

Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant
Shape how life-changing therapies reach patients — by helping pharmaceutical companies navigate the payer and market access landscape with sharper intelligence.
ZS's Value & Access practice partners with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies to solve their most pressing market access and reimbursement challenges. Our work spans payer strategy, pricing architecture, access program design, and reimbursement research grounded in direct, rigorous primary research with the payers, PBMs, and providers who make coverage and formulary decisions every day.
As an Associate Consultant , you'll be in the room conducting in-depth interviews with managed care decision-makers, synthesizing findings into access strategies, and helping clients understand the coverage and reimbursement landscape before and after launch.
What you’ll do
· Translate complex payer and provider intelligence into access landscape assessments, coverage barrier analyses, and reimbursement risk frameworks that guide pre-launch and in-market strategy
· Lead pricing and contracting strategy projects, synthesizing WAC/net pricing benchmarks, formulary positioning data, and competitive access dynamics into actionable recommendations
· Oversee quantitative analyses using claims data, formulary databases, and pricing benchmarks, ensuring analytical rigor and strategic coherence across workstreams.
· Structure and deliver executive-level presentations to senior client stakeholders, including VP and C-suite market access and commercial leaders
· Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Associates and Associate Consultants — setting the standard for research quality, client presence, and professional growth
· Contribute to ZS's Value & Access thought leadership, proposal development, and capability building as a recognized expert in the payer and reimbursement space
· Gain immediate familiarity with client’s internal processes.
· Develop expertise within a client analytics area.
· Be available for clients during regular working hours.
What you’ll bring
· MBA with a bachelor's (and often graduate) degree in a quantitative, analytical discipline, such as Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Management Science, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, or Engineering.
· 3+ years of market access, payer strategy, or reimbursement consulting experience in or serving the pharmaceutical industry with a track record of leading engagements, not just contributing to them
· Demonstrated expertise conducting qualitative primary research with U.S. payers, PBMs, and providers; including experience designing research programs and moderating senior-level interviews independently
· Comprehensive fluency in the U.S. payer landscape: managed care organizations, Medicare Part B and D, Medicaid, formulary management, prior authorization, step therapy, and specialty pharmacy channels
· Command of pharmaceutical pricing strategy and contracting — WAC, net pricing, rebate structures, value-based agreements, and GPO/IDN dynamics
· Strong analytical foundation — able to oversee and pressure-test claims data analyses, formulary database modeling, and pricing benchmarking work
· Proven ability to lead client relationships with autonomy. You manage expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and consistently earn trust with senior stakeholders
· Experience leading and developing junior consultants, with a genuine investment in their growth
· Fluency in English
· Client-first mentality
· Intense work ethic
· Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach
How you’ll grow:
· Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
· Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
· Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions
Perks & Benefits:
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States , visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS .
Hybrid working model:
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
Travel:
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
Considering applying?
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. About Sattva
We
Partner
to deliver social impact at scale
Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.
Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: 
www.sattva.co.in

The Foundations team collaborates with a network of global philanthropic foundations, alongside multilateral aid agencies, aiming to inform, influence, and profoundly impact social and environmental outcomes resulting from their investments in diverse sectors such as education, child development, gender, health, and more. Our primary focus is on catalysing ecosystem transformation by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound, effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged while their interests are covered.
The Opportunity
As an Associate in the Foundations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact.
In this role, you will be embedded within the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship for twelve months. The following will be your key responsibilities:
Key responsibilities:
Problem Solving
Understands the problem deeply and asks the right questions in teams discussions.
Identifies key data and information through primary and secondary research and builds strategic narratives for communicating data and research insights with the key message.
Entrepreneurial, bringing high bias for execution and client focus; asks relevant stakeholders for help when required.
Delivery Excellence
Collaborates effectively with internal and external stakeholders (including government stakeholders) and manages relevant resources in order to deliver on one's work.
Ensures that they plan ahead and work smart to achieve all their deliverables.
Tracks overall project progress and is able to flag when things are not on track.
Ensure creation and adoption of high-quality assets, methods, and standards created during delivery.
Stakeholder Engagement
Establishes a deep rapport with the middle management of the client organization through constant engagement and personal credibility.
Listens actively to clients and understands both articulated and unarticulated needs.
Presents own point of view convincingly using relevant information, arguments, and examples.
Project Management
Plans day to day responsibilities effectively at an individual level.
Possesses excellent time management and prioritization skills to work on key activities that are directly linked to impact outcomes.
Proactively monitors and reports any risk in individual/project milestones.
Maintains thorough documentation of key project knowledge assets.
Give and receive constructive feedback to the team members in a respectable manner.
Skills Required
At Sattva, our goal is realizing the impact on the ground and to drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. We are looking for individuals who align with our mission of alleviating poverty in our lifetime and have the following profile:
2-4 years of experience in problem-solving and stakeholder management in consulting firms or government bodies.
Prior embedded Government experience: a placement, secondment, fellowship or strategy-unit role inside a Ministry, a State Government or a Government body. Experience with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship is highly desirable.
Demonstrated ability to work with Government officials and navigate inter-ministerial decision-making.
Exceptional problem-solving and advisory skills, strong presentation and data analytical abilities.
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas effectively.
Ability to organize own work and manage own time with minimal supervision.
Why Sattva?
It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design.
Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment.
Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can.
Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow.
How to Prepare?
This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.

At Frost & Sullivan, we help businesses navigate disruption, unlock growth opportunities and turn ambitious strategies into measurable business outcomes.

Lead multiple client engagements from problem definition and research through analysis, strategic recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

Ensure the quality, commercial relevance and timely delivery of client outcomes.
Apply Frost & Sullivan’s Growth Pipeline Engine (GPE) framework to help clients identify, prioritise and accelerate growth opportunities.
Facilitate Growth Pipeline Dialogs and contribute to the continuous improvement of consulting tools, frameworks and delivery approaches.

Proactively identify, develop and convert new business opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts.
Build relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers to uncover business challenges, understand growth priorities and position relevant consulting solutions.

Represent Frost & Sullivan’s insights, proprietary frameworks and Growth Pipeline methodologies in client and industry forums.
Contribute thought leadership content, industry perspectives and practice-specific initiatives that strengthen our market positioning.

Facilitate challenging discussions, align stakeholders and build consensus around strategic priorities and recommendations.

Anticipate project risks, address emerging issues and communicate solutions effectively.

A foundational understanding of the ICT industry, including its structure, operating models, competitive landscape and emerging trends.
Experience managing complex projects, engaging senior stakeholders and delivering high-quality client outcomes.
Exposure to business development, consultative selling, account management or revenue-generating activities is highly desirable.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking
Strong research, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to develop evidence-based recommendations.
Ability to connect data, market trends and business implications into a coherent, compelling story.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, structured and persuasive reports in professional English.
Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of how consulting solutions create measurable business value.
Business Development & Client Influence
Confidence in initiating conversations, building professional networks and developing lasting client relationships.
Ability to identify client needs, qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions and contribute to winning new business.
Strong presentation, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to defend recommendations with confidence and professionalism.
Willingness to represent Frost & Sullivan through executive presentations, public speaking, webinars and industry engagements.
Personal Effectiveness & Leadership
Self-driven, entrepreneurial and comfortable taking ownership with minimal supervision.
Well-organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
Collaborative, adaptable and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
Able to mentor colleagues, share knowledge and contribute to a high-performance team culture.
Disciplined in maintaining analytical rigour, professional integrity and consistently high-quality standards.
